prs.title: test(integration): give the editor-parity waits the shared-pool stall tier (#17544)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Raises the polling ceiling used by the interactive editor-parity acceptance suite so that a mid-turn repaint on the shared runner pool gets the same stall allowance the harness already grants the CLI at startup. The suite's local wait budget goes from 12s to 30s, and the shared wait helper triples that in CI, which lands the CI ceiling exactly on the 90s self-hosted boot tier. Both waits named in the flake report go through that one helper, so a single ceiling change covers both signatures. Every assertion, every input and every probe condition is untouched — nothing is skipped, retried, wrapped or loosened — and a small pin ships alongside so the ceiling cannot silently drift back below the boot tier.

## Why it's needed

CI Failure Patrol saw two waits in this suite expire on one commit and pass on a rerun of the same commit: the search/Tab/Escape case waiting for the model reply to become visible, and the streaming-cancel case waiting for the cancelled prompt to return to the composer. Both are waits for a repaint after a key press, and the suite is fully mocked against a local fake provider, so no real model latency is involved.

The harness already records that this shared pool stalls the very same CLI for much longer than the mid-turn ceiling allowed: the ready-prompt budget documentation describes a boot exhausting 30s on all three retries and another exhausting 90s, and grants 90s on self-hosted runners and 180s on self-hosted docker as a result. The mid-turn ceiling was 36s in CI — below the boot tier for the same host — so a stall the harness already tolerates at startup expired a wait in the middle of a test. An earlier change raised this whole family's wait ceilings for exactly this signature class; this file kept the second-lowest budget in the family while containing its longest and most interaction-dense cases.

One detail matters when reading the report: the polling helper throws only its label, never the screen it last saw, so "no content mismatch" describes the error text rather than a screen verified healthy. The investigation therefore checked the alternatives against code and captured frame evidence instead of trusting the signature. CPU contention was ruled out by pinning the whole test tree to a single core shared with three busy loops — the cases still passed, because the suite is dominated by its own fixed settles. Reply-label desynchronisation was ruled out by confirming one request per submit with matching labels and every background model caller disabled. Viewport scroll-off was ruled out by measuring the waited-for reply's row in every captured frame: it is always the newest transcript line, directly above a fixed six-row footer. The product's cancel/restore branch was traced and takes the restore path for a held stream that has already rendered content.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the suite the way the parity leg does, from `integration-tests`, with the sandbox off and retries disabled: `CI=true QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run interactive/tui-editor-parity.test.ts interactive/tui-editor-parity-wait-budget.test.ts --retry=0 --maxWorkers=1 --minWorkers=1`. Expect all 30 cases green (29 acceptance cases plus the new pin), with the search/Tab/Escape case around 33s.

Confirm the pin actually witnesses the ceiling by reverting the budget literal to `12_000` and re-running just the pin: it must fail with `expected 36000 to be greater than or equal to 90000`. Restore the literal and it passes. This probe was run before committing, in that order.

Confirm the change is ceiling-only: the acceptance diff is one numeric literal plus an explanatory comment, with no assertion, input, key sequence or probe condition altered.

Two limits are worth knowing before reviewing. The flake did not reproduce locally — 18 pre-fix executions of the named case were green, including the harshest contention surrogate — so the ceiling is calibrated against the pool's recorded stall incidents and the existing boot policy, not against a local reproduction. And `bun` is not installed on this runner, so the bun+ink and bun+opentui legs were not exercised; if the stall is specific to the native renderer, CI remains the authority.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test-only change with no user-visible behavior. For the record: the CI wait ceiling moves from 36s to 90s and the local ceiling from 12s to 30s; post-fix the whole suite plus the pin passed 30/30 on two consecutive runs, and the pin failed against the pre-fix ceiling with the assertion quoted above.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Node v22.23.2 on Linux, driving the prebuilt bundle with `QWEN_SANDBOX=false` on the node+ink renderer leg, `CI=true` for the scaled budgets. `bun` is not installed, so the other two renderer legs were unavailable.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a genuinely stuck UI now takes up to 90s in CI and 30s locally to fail a wait, instead of 36s and 12s. The two reported cases inherit the suite's 300s per-test ceiling, so they still fail on the wait's own label. The three permissions cases pin a 90s per-test ceiling of their own; under a stall they would now report the suite timeout rather than the wait label, and they still fail either way. Local failure diagnosis for this file is correspondingly slower, which is the unavoidable consequence of the helper coupling its local and CI budgets by a factor of three.
- Not validated / out of scope: no local reproduction of the flake; the bun+ink and bun+opentui legs; and `npm run build`, which this sandbox cannot run because corepack is denied write access to its cache outside the project (`EACCES: permission denied, mkdir '/home/github-runner/.cache/node/corepack/v1'`). The diff touches no workspace package — the integration tree has no manifest and is not a workspace member — so the per-package build never compiles it. `npm run typecheck` (all workspaces plus the integration program), `npm run lint` and Prettier all passed. No product code, CI machinery, shared wait policy or configuration was changed.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #17544

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

提高交互式 editor-parity 验收套件所使用的轮询上限，使共享 runner 池上回合中途的重绘，获得 harness 在 CLI 启动阶段已经给予的同等卡顿余量。该套件的本地等待预算从 12s 提高到 30s，共享等待助手在 CI 中将其三倍放大，于是 CI 上限正好落在 90s 的自托管启动档位上。抖动报告中提到的两个等待都经过这一个助手，因此单处上限改动即可覆盖两个签名。所有断言、所有输入、所有探针条件均未改动——没有跳过、没有重试、没有包裹、也没有放宽——并随附一个小型 pin，使该上限不会悄悄回落到启动档位之下。

## 为什么需要它

CI Failure Patrol 看到该套件中两个等待在同一个 commit 上超时，并在同一 commit 的重跑中通过：search/Tab/Escape 用例等待模型回复可见，streaming-cancel 用例等待被取消的提示词回到输入框。两者都是按键之后等待重绘，而该套件完全基于本地 fake provider 做 mock，不涉及任何真实模型延迟。

harness 已经记录过：这个共享池让同一个 CLI 卡住的时间远超回合中途上限所允许的值——ready-prompt 预算文档描述了一次启动在三次重试中全部耗尽 30s，另一次耗尽 90s，并据此给予自托管 runner 90s、自托管 docker 180s。而回合中途的 CI 上限是 36s，低于同一主机的启动档位，于是 harness 在启动阶段已经容忍的卡顿，在测试中途让等待超时。此前已有一处改动针对完全相同的签名类别提高了整个家族的等待上限；而这个文件保留了家族中第二低的预算，却包含家族中最长、交互最密集的用例。

阅读报告时有一个细节很重要：轮询助手抛出的只有标签，从不附带它最后看到的屏幕，因此“没有内容不符”描述的是错误文本，而不是一块被验证为健康的屏幕。所以本次排查是对照代码与采集到的帧证据去核实各种可能，而不是相信签名本身。CPU 争用已被排除：把整棵测试进程树绑到与三个忙循环共享的单个核上，用例依然通过，因为该套件的时间主要花在自身的固定 settle 上。回复标签错位已被排除：确认每次提交对应一个请求且标签一致，并且所有后台模型调用方都已关闭。可视区滚出已被排除：逐帧测量被等待回复所在的行，它始终是最新的一条 transcript 行，紧邻固定的六行页脚之上。产品侧的取消/恢复分支也已追踪，对于已经渲染出内容的 held 流，它走的是恢复路径。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

按 parity leg 的方式运行该套件：在 `integration-tests` 目录下，关闭 sandbox 并禁用重试：`CI=true QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run interactive/tui-editor-parity.test.ts interactive/tui-editor-parity-wait-budget.test.ts --retry=0 --maxWorkers=1 --minWorkers=1`。预期 30 个用例全绿（29 个验收用例加新增 pin），其中 search/Tab/Escape 用例约 33s。

要确认该 pin 真的见证了上限，可把预算字面量回退为 `12_000` 并只重跑该 pin：它必须失败并报 `expected 36000 to be greater than or equal to 90000`。恢复字面量后即通过。提交前已按此顺序执行过该探针。

确认本改动只涉及上限：验收文件的 diff 是一个数字字面量加一段解释性注释，没有任何断言、输入、按键序列或探针条件被改动。

评审前值得知道两个边界。抖动在本地没有复现——修复前命名用例的 18 次执行全部通过，其中包括最严苛的争用 surrogate——因此上限是按该池已记录的卡顿事故与既有启动策略定标的，而不是按本地复现定标的。另外本 runner 未安装 `bun`，所以 bun+ink 与 bun+opentui 两条 leg 未被执行；如果卡顿特定于原生渲染器，CI 仍是最终权威。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A —— 仅测试改动，没有用户可见行为变化。备查：CI 等待上限从 36s 提高到 90s，本地上限从 12s 提高到 30s；修复后整个套件加 pin 连续两轮均 30/30 通过，而该 pin 面对修复前的上限失败，报上文引用的断言。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 已测试 |

### 环境（可选）

Linux 上的 Node v22.23.2，以 `QWEN_SANDBOX=false` 在 node+ink 渲染器 leg 上驱动预构建 bundle，并用 `CI=true` 启用放大后的预算。未安装 `bun`，因此另外两条渲染器 leg 不可用。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：真正卡死的 UI 现在在 CI 中最多需要 90s、本地最多 30s 才会让某个等待失败，而不是原来的 36s 与 12s。两个被报告的用例继承套件 300s 的单用例上限，因此仍会以该等待自身的标签失败。三个 permissions 用例各自固定了 90s 的单用例上限；在卡顿情况下它们现在会报套件超时而不是等待标签，但两种情况下都仍然失败。相应地，本文件的本地失败诊断会变慢，这是助手把本地与 CI 预算按三倍耦合所不可避免的结果。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：抖动的本地复现；bun+ink 与 bun+opentui 两条 leg；以及 `npm run build`——本沙箱无法运行它，因为 corepack 被拒绝写入项目之外的缓存（`EACCES: permission denied, mkdir '/home/github-runner/.cache/node/corepack/v1'`）。本 diff 不触及任何 workspace 包——集成树没有 manifest，也不是 workspace 成员——因此逐包构建根本不会编译它。`npm run typecheck`（所有 workspace 加集成 program）、`npm run lint` 与 Prettier 均已通过。未改动任何产品代码、CI 机制、共享等待策略或配置。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## Linked Issues

Fixes #17544

</details>

prs.title: fix(test): isolate the standalone runtime regression from inherited session env (#17966)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes the standalone runtime regression hermetic against the ambient environment: before any probe runs, the test worker now drops the environment keys the production launcher honors (`CLI_VERSION`, `QWEN_CODE_RELAUNCH_ARGS`) plus the preload injectors (`NODE_OPTIONS`, `BUN_OPTIONS`) — the same key set the suite's ambient scenario already strips for its own control probes. A source-pinning witness test next to the existing standalone-suite budget test keeps the guard in place. Test-only change; no production code is touched.

## Why it's needed

The v0.28.3 release failed at its `quality` gate (#17966). Reproducing every quality sub-check locally against the release commit showed the standalone runtime regression — part of the release's script-tests job — fails deterministically whenever the surrounding environment carries a qwen session's stamps: the launcher answers `--version` from `CLI_VERSION` before it ever reads the fixture metadata, so the "metadata-only positive control" asserts the outer session's version (`0.28.0`) against the fixture's `1.2.3` and the whole release gate fails closed. The release validates on the dedicated self-hosted pool that also hosts qwen automation, and jobs on that fleet can inherit a session's environment (this autofix job's own environment carries the full stamp set); the release runner preparation isolates Git/npm/Docker/gh state but not these variables. The suite already acknowledged this pollution class for its ambient controls but left the rest of the worker exposed.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run `CLI_VERSION=0.28.0 QWEN_CODE_RELAUNCH_ARGS='["--version"]' npm run test:standalone:runtimes:ci` after `npm run build`. Before this change the node worker dies at phase `node/direct/missing` with `AssertionError: metadata-only positive control '0.28.0' !== '1.2.3'`; after it, both the node and bun workers complete and the command exits 0. The same run under a clean environment passes both before and after (baseline). The new witness in the release-workflow script suite fails when the guard is removed and passes with it restored (mutation-probed both directions). The full release quality matrix was also reproduced green: lint, typecheck, all three workspace-test shards in a clean CI-like environment, the serve-fast-path bundle check, the full build, pack-build, and verify-package.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (non-UI). Before, with inherited session stamps: `{"host":"node","failurePhase":"node/direct/missing",...}` followed by `AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: metadata-only positive control '0.28.0' !== '1.2.3'`. After, same environment: `{"host":"node","complete":true,...}`, `{"host":"bun","complete":true,...}`, exit 0.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Self-hosted Linux runner (Node 22), pinned Node/Bun runtime archives fetched by the suite itself; clean CI-like environment for the baseline runs (`env -i` with fresh HOME), full session environment for the pollution runs. The suite is POSIX-only by design (Windows skips it).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: stripping `NODE_OPTIONS`/`BUN_OPTIONS` at worker start also sanitizes the early registry-entry probes; that is the intended hermeticity and matches what the suite's outer spawner already does for direct runs. Both runtime hosts pass the complete matrix after the change, including under the full session environment.
- Not validated / out of scope: the exact failing sub-check of release run 44841519782 cannot be confirmed without log access; this fix addresses the only reproducible defect found across the whole quality matrix. macOS/Windows not exercised (the fixture is POSIX-only). Twenty script-suite lint-lane failures seen during reproduction were traced to this sandbox lacking the `file` utility (probe: `spawnSync file ENOENT`), and two workspace failures to the session's `SANDBOX` stamp — both ruled out with focused clean-environment reruns, not product defects.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; test infrastructure only.

## 本 PR 做了什么

v0.28.3 发布在其 `quality` 门禁处失败（#17966）。在发布提交上本地复现每一个质量子检查后发现：只要周围环境携带 qwen 会话的印记，独立运行时回归测试（发布脚本测试任务的一部分）就会确定性失败——启动器在读取 fixture 元数据之前就用 `CLI_VERSION` 回答 `--version`，于是“仅元数据阳性对照”拿外层会话的版本（`0.28.0`）去断言 fixture 的 `1.2.3`，整个发布门禁随之失败关闭。发布在专用自托管池上验证，该池同时承载 qwen 自动化，该机群的任务可以继承会话环境（本 autofix 任务自身的环境就携带完整印记集）；发布 runner 的准备工作隔离了 Git/npm/Docker/gh 状态，但没有隔离这些变量。套件早已为 ambient 对照承认了这类污染，却让其馀 worker 暴露在外。

### 证据（改动前后）

N/A（非 UI）。改动前，继承会话印记时：`{"host":"node","failurePhase":"node/direct/missing",...}`，随后 `AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: metadata-only positive control '0.28.0' !== '1.2.3'`。改动后，同一环境：`{"host":"node","complete":true,...}`、`{"host":"bun","complete":true,...}`，exit 0。

- 主要风险/权衡：在 worker 启动时剥离 `NODE_OPTIONS`/`BUN_OPTIONS` 也会净化早期的 registry-entry 探针；这正是预期的封闭性，且与套件外层 spawner 对直接运行已有的处理一致。改动后两个运行时宿主均通过完整矩阵，包括完整会话环境下。

prs.title: feat(core): add local notes compaction with a strategy selector
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds an opt-in local notes compaction strategy. Users can select **Summary** or **Notes and History** under **Chat Compression Strategy** in `/settings`, or set `model.chatCompression.strategy` to `summary` or `notes` in `settings.json`. Summary remains the default; changing the selection requires restarting Qwen Code.

Eligible main sessions gain `session_notes`, `session_history`, `get_context_remaining`, and `new_context`. The model can persist a bounded working checkpoint, start a smaller context from that checkpoint and the latest consumed user request, and recover omitted evidence from the active branch of its local session log. Successful notes rollovers make no summarization request. Notes revisions live in the existing JSONL transcript, with a generated Markdown projection for inspection; checkpoint persistence must succeed before active history changes. Resume, fork, rewind, archive, and deletion handle the matching notes state.

Missing, stale, or unusable notes fall back to summary for automatic and ordinary manual compression. An explicit `new_context` requires a fresh revision and reports an error if it cannot commit. `/compress <instructions>` continues to summarize, and `/compress-fast` keeps its existing behavior. The notes tool bundle respects recording availability and tool policy and is excluded from subagents, teammates, and nested code-mode calls. Ink and OpenTUI display a notes-specific transition notice.

## Why it's needed

Repeated full-history summaries can lose constraints, decisions, and tool evidence that a long task needs later. A local working checkpoint plus bounded history retrieval gives the model a way to carry forward its current state and recover details on demand. Storage and retrieval use the existing session log and require no additional memory backend. Selected notes and retrieved history still go to the configured model provider as normal inference input. Real-model quality, total token cost, and latency remain to be measured before considering a default change.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start the local build with no strategy configured and confirm summary behavior. Open `/settings`, search for `compression`, switch to **Notes and History**, and confirm the saved value is `model.chatCompression.strategy: "notes"` and the restart notice appears. Restart and check that the four notes tools are available. Repeat with `summary`, including activation through `settings.json`.
2. In an isolated recorded session, have the model write notes and request a new context in separate tool-only responses using the returned revision. Repeat three times. Each new context should retain the checkpoint and current user constraints, with no summarizer request. Deliberately omit an earlier identifier from the notes, then recover it through history search/read. Resume the session and check that its latest notes revision and old history reference still work.
3. Check that missing/stale revisions, oversized notes, and notes/reset calls mixed with ordinary text or tools cannot install a new context. Disabling recording or denying a required notes tool should disable the complete bundle. After switching to a smaller model window, existing bounded notes should remain readable, while an oversized checkpoint must be shortened before it can authorize a reset.
4. Compare compression commands: `/compress` with fresh notes should use notes; missing/stale notes should fall back to summary; `/compress <instructions>` should forward those instructions to the summarizer even with fresh notes; `/compress-fast` should retain its current tool-output clearing behavior. Check that the next model request uses the committed context and that notes transitions show the notes-specific notice.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Actual tmux captures of `/settings`, with the search set to `compression`:

**Before — global `qwen` `0.23.3-nightly.20260913.faa395885e`:**

```text
No settings match your search.
```

**After — local bundle `0.24.1`:**

```text
Chat Compression Strategy                                                   Notes and History*
Choose summary compression or local notes with history recovery. Restart Qwen Code to apply.
To see changes, Qwen Code must be restarted. Press r to exit and apply changes now.
```

The fresh-notes `/compress` case displayed `Started a new context from local notes` in the actual TUI. The complete deterministic headless/tmux run passed settings persistence, tool availability, history recovery/resume, six rejection cases, and all six manual-compression cases. After the final fixes, the rebuilt handoff rerun again committed **three distinct notes windows in 15 main requests with zero summarizer requests**; resume took three requests and restored the same notes revision and historical reference.

`npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, and `npm run bundle` passed. Relevant core, ACP, settings/schema/i18n, and Ink/OpenTUI regression tests passed. The final focused rerun passed 23 core tests and 54 event-adapter tests; the commit hook also passed formatting and ESLint. A separate comment contains the E2E matrix and coverage limits.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64, Node.js `v26.8.2`; local bundled CLI `0.24.1`; isolated temporary settings and runtime directories; deterministic localhost OpenAI-compatible provider; headless CLI and real tmux interaction. The user's normal settings and sessions were not modified by the tests.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: This changes core recording, compaction, and replay paths. Correctness depends on fresh notes, successful checkpoint persistence, and branch-correct recovery; note completeness still depends on the model. The Markdown file is a generated view, so editing it directly does not update canonical notes.
- Not validated / out of scope: Real-model task quality, token/cost/latency comparisons, full ACP/Web Shell E2E, other provider wire protocols, process-crash/disk/lease fault injection, and Windows/Linux execution. The deterministic E2E suite does not cover automatic/hard-overflow triggers, nested code mode, or fork/rewind/archive lifecycle operations; focused regression tests cover relevant runtime paths, without claiming end-to-end coverage. Cross-session memory, multi-file notes, and a notes editor are out of scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: No settings migration is required. `summary` remains the default, existing transcripts remain supported, and enabling or disabling `notes` requires a restart. Ordinary compression can use summary fallback; an explicit `new_context` never silently summarizes.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/158a0511ddcdd465e14083c56d0f9c7cc8ac629a/docs/design/2026-09-19-local-notes-compaction.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/158a0511ddcdd465e14083c56d0f9c7cc8ac629a/docs/design/2026-09-19-local-notes-compaction.zh-CN.md). Both versions are complete and synchronized, including decisions, constraints, acceptance criteria, and follow-up validation.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #12257

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的内容

增加可选的本地 notes 压缩策略。用户可以在 `/settings` 的 **上下文压缩方式** 中选择 **摘要** 或 **笔记与历史**，也可以在 `settings.json` 中把 `model.chatCompression.strategy` 设为 `summary` 或 `notes`。默认仍为摘要；修改选项后需要重启 Qwen Code。

符合条件的主会话获得 `session_notes`、`session_history`、`get_context_remaining` 和 `new_context` 四个工具。模型可以保存有大小限制的工作笔记，从笔记和最近已消费的用户请求启动更小的上下文，再从本地 session log 的有效分支找回遗漏证据。成功的 notes 换窗口不发起摘要请求。笔记版本保存在现有 JSONL transcript 中，并生成方便查看的 Markdown 文件；只有恢复 checkpoint 持久化成功后才替换当前历史。恢复、分叉、回退、归档和删除操作会处理对应的笔记状态。

自动压缩和普通手动压缩在笔记缺失、过期或不可用时回退到摘要。显式调用 `new_context` 必须提供新鲜的笔记版本，无法提交时返回错误。`/compress <instructions>` 继续生成摘要，`/compress-fast` 保持现有行为。笔记工具组遵循录制可用性及工具策略，并对 subagent、teammate 和嵌套 code-mode 调用关闭。Ink 和 OpenTUI 会显示专门的 notes 换窗口提示。

## 为什么需要

反复生成全历史摘要可能丢失长任务后续需要的约束、决策和工具证据。本地工作笔记加上有界历史检索，使模型能够保留当前工作状态并按需找回细节。存储和检索复用现有 session log，不需要新增 memory 后端。选中的笔记和检索出的历史仍会作为正常推理输入发送给配置的模型 provider。在考虑修改默认策略前，仍需评估真实模型的任务质量、总 token 成本和延迟。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 使用本地构建启动，不配置策略时确认仍使用摘要。打开 `/settings`，搜索 `compression`，切换到 **Notes and History**，确认保存的值为 `model.chatCompression.strategy: "notes"` 并显示重启提示。重启后检查四个笔记工具可用。再切回 `summary`，并验证通过 `settings.json` 启用的行为一致。
2. 在隔离且开启录制的会话中，让模型先写笔记，再用返回的 revision 请求新上下文；两次调用分别放在独立且只含该工具的回复中。重复三次。每个新上下文都应保留 checkpoint 和当前用户约束，且不发起摘要请求。故意不把某个早期标识符写入笔记，再通过历史搜索和读取找回。恢复会话后，检查最新笔记版本和旧历史引用仍可用。
3. 检查缺失或过期的 revision、超限笔记，以及混入普通文本或其他工具的笔记/换窗口调用，都不能安装新上下文。关闭录制或拒绝任一必需工具后，整个笔记工具组应被关闭。切换到窗口更小的模型后，已有且满足固定大小上限的笔记仍应可读，但超过当前模型预算的 checkpoint 必须缩短后才能用于换窗口。
4. 对比压缩命令：笔记新鲜时 `/compress` 应使用笔记；笔记缺失或过期时应回退到摘要；即使有新鲜笔记，`/compress <instructions>` 也应把指定要求转交摘要模型；`/compress-fast` 应保留现有清理工具输出的行为。检查下一次模型请求使用已提交的上下文，且 notes 换窗口显示对应提示。

### 证据（前后对比）

以下为真实 tmux 捕获的 `/settings` 画面节选，搜索词为 `compression`：

**修改前：全局 `qwen` `0.23.3-nightly.20260913.faa395885e`：**

```text
No settings match your search.
```

**修改后：本地 bundle `0.24.1`：**

```text
Chat Compression Strategy                                                   Notes and History*
Choose summary compression or local notes with history recovery. Restart Qwen Code to apply.
To see changes, Qwen Code must be restarted. Press r to exit and apply changes now.
```

使用新鲜笔记执行 `/compress` 时，真实 TUI 显示 `Started a new context from local notes`。完整的确定性 headless/tmux 测试通过了设置持久化、工具可用性、历史找回与会话恢复、六项拒绝场景以及全部六项手动压缩场景。最终修复后重新构建并复测交接，再次在 **15 次主模型请求中提交了三个不同的 notes 窗口，摘要请求为零**；恢复过程使用三次请求，恢复了相同的笔记版本和历史引用。

`npm run build`、`npm run typecheck` 和 `npm run bundle` 均通过。相关 core、ACP、设置/schema/国际化、Ink/OpenTUI 回归测试均通过。最后的针对性复测通过了 23 个 core 测试和 54 个 event-adapter 测试；提交钩子的格式和 ESLint 检查也通过。另附评论列出 E2E 场景矩阵和覆盖范围。

### 测试平台

| 平台 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境（可选）

macOS arm64、Node.js `v26.8.2`、本地 CLI bundle `0.24.1`；使用隔离的临时设置和 runtime 目录、确定性的 localhost OpenAI 兼容模型服务、headless CLI 和真实 tmux 交互。测试未修改用户日常使用的设置和会话。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：涉及 core 的录制、压缩和回放路径。正确性依赖笔记新鲜度、checkpoint 成功持久化以及有效分支恢复；笔记内容是否完整仍依赖模型。Markdown 文件只是生成视图，直接编辑不会更新权威笔记。
- 未验证或不在范围内：真实模型任务质量、token/成本/延迟对比、完整 ACP/Web Shell E2E、其他 provider 的通信协议、进程崩溃/磁盘/写入租约故障注入，以及 Windows/Linux 运行。确定性 E2E 未覆盖自动/硬溢出触发、嵌套 code mode 或分叉/回退/归档生命周期操作；针对性回归测试覆盖了相关运行时路径，但不代表完成了这些场景的端到端验证。跨会话记忆、多文件笔记和笔记编辑器不在本次范围内。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无需迁移设置。默认仍为 `summary`，继续支持已有 transcript；开启或关闭 `notes` 需要重启。普通压缩可以回退到摘要；显式 `new_context` 绝不会悄悄改用摘要。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/158a0511ddcdd465e14083c56d0f9c7cc8ac629a/docs/design/2026-09-19-local-notes-compaction.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/158a0511ddcdd465e14083c56d0f9c7cc8ac629a/docs/design/2026-09-19-local-notes-compaction.zh-CN.md)。两个版本完整同步，包括决策、约束、验收标准和后续验证。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #12257

</details>

prs.title: fix(acp): handle authRequired, subscription/qoder auth methods, and model catalog projection
prs.body:
## Summary
Fixes #17210

### Root Cause
1. In `1.0.0-preview`, `AcpServer` left `buildAuthMethods()` returning `[]`, `authenticate()` throwing `Unknown auth method`, and had no usable-model readiness gate before inference. When subscription credentials were absent or invalidated (e.g., cleared on `invalid_grant`), sessions were created with zero usable models and failed at prompt time with internal error `A session ModelProvider is required for inference.` (HTTP 500) instead of standard ACP `authRequired` (`-32000`).
2. `createDefaultAcpModelAdapter()` returned a hardcoded `[{ modelId: config.getModel() || 'auto' }]` without querying `ModelProviderManager.listModels()`, so ACP clients (e.g., Zed) only saw `auto` even after signing in.

### Changes
- **ACP Auth Strategy Coordinator (`packages/cli/src/acp/acpAuth.ts`, `acpServer.ts`, `acpAppFramework.ts`)**:
  - Added strategy-based `AcpAuthCoordinator` advertising standard ACP `authMethods` (`qwen-subscription`, `qoder-oauth:global`, `qoder-oauth:cn`) and implementing `authenticate()` with in-flight deduplication, browser launch + `authenticate/update` notification, settings persistence, and per-session isolated provider hot-attachment to active sessions.
  - Added provider-agnostic `protected ensureSessionProvidersReady()` on `newSession` / `prompt` that returns standard ACP `RequestError.authRequired` (`-32000`) when no usable models are available (skips when `fakeResponses` is enabled, and fast-paths aligned `prompt()` calls).
  - Fixed `syncSessionModelsAndNotify()` so `modelsChanged` is accumulated across model sync and `config_option_update` is sent reliably after `authenticate()`.
- **Domain Errors & Subscription Plan Rule (`packages/core`)**:
  - Added typed `MissingSessionModelProviderError` + `MISSING_SESSION_MODEL_PROVIDER_MESSAGE` (thrown in `model-request-execution.ts` and `request-preparation.ts`).
  - Extracted shared `isPaidQwenSubscriptionPlan()` and exported `QWEN_SUBSCRIPTION_SIGNED_OUT_HINT` so `AuthDialog.tsx` and ACP share a single source of truth.
- **ACP Error Mapping & Model Catalog Projection (`acpSessionHost.ts`, `acpSupport.ts`)**:
  - Mapped `FatalAuthenticationError`, `MissingSessionModelProviderError`, `QwenSubscriptionOAuthError` (`session_changed` / `invalid_grant` / `401`), and `QWEN_SUBSCRIPTION_SIGNED_OUT_HINT` to ACP `RequestError.authRequired` with `authMethods`, while preserving generic HTTP `401` for custom API-key providers.

prs.title: feat(web-shell): add the contract-driven ChatSurface chat column
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Lands the shared chat column renderer for the unified chat surface migration: a backend-neutral component that renders a chat column entirely from the session chat controller view model — the transcript, the active tool approval, the active question, and the composer — with header, panels, composer status, and the localized transcript-unavailable UI arriving as slots. It never branches on the backend kind; a region renders only when its facts are present. To let the surface drive the shared approval and question components, the contract's pending approval and pending question items now carry a render-ready permission request (the backend-neutral shared message model), and the daemon binding populates it inside the existing content-signature cache so no per-streaming-delta extraction is reintroduced. The composer clears its draft on admission, never on establishment, keeping the admission-is-not-establishment invariant. This slice is additive: the component is not wired into a column yet, so nothing renders differently today.

## Why it's needed

The migration converges the daemon main column, the split-view/side-task column, and the managed column onto one surface so a new chat feature is built once and reaches every column. The kernel and the daemon adapter already landed, but no component rendered a column from the contract, and the contract's pending items carried only an id/status summary — not enough to drive the shared approval/question components, which consume a full permission request. This slice provides the surface and closes that contract gap, unblocking the daemon main-column switch (with the visual before/after gate) as the next increment.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the chat-core and daemon chat suites from `packages/web-shell`: `npx vitest run client/chat-core/ client/daemon/useDaemonChatController.test.tsx client/daemon/chat-controller.test.ts client/daemon/chat-intents.test.ts client/daemon/permission-signals.test.ts` — 155 tests pass, including 11 new composition tests that pin the surface's contract-to-props wiring (transcript facts, first-pending approval selection skipping superseded items, approval/question confirmation routing and answer normalization, draft clearing only on accepted admission, cancel routing, running-phase derivation, error-slot rendering, and slot passthrough). Type gates: `npx tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json --noEmit` and `npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` both pass; targeted ESLint and Prettier are clean. Confirm the surface imports no daemon value (the eight shared components it composes carry only type-only SDK imports).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — additive, not yet rendered; the visual before/after gate belongs to the main-column switch increment.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests + type gates only (jsdom); no runtime UI change in this slice.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the surface is not yet wired into a column, so its real-world rendering is proven by the next (switch) increment's visual gate; the composition tests pin the contract-to-props wiring meanwhile.
- Not validated / out of scope: the daemon main-column switch and visual before/after gate (next increment); status-stack/usage-stat parity (needs richer status facts); the managed adapter and split-view convergence.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: the contract extension is additive and backend-neutral; the daemon binding is the only populated adapter today.

Design document: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/unified-chat-surface-slice2e-chat-surface/docs/design/2026-11-21-chat-surface.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/unified-chat-surface-slice2e-chat-surface/docs/design/2026-11-21-chat-surface.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Part of #17460 (unified Managed Agent and Daemon Web UI). Builds on #17520, #17684, #17709, #17794, #17895.

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A——增量、尚未渲染；视觉前后对比门属于主列切换增量。

## 风险与范围

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): create the ephemeral Runtime state directory at spawn, not at provider creation
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Completes the lazy state-directory fix for the local Runtime provisioner, addressing review rounds 1–4 and verification findings F1–F5:

- **Spawn-time creation**: the state-directory ensure lives in `LocalProcessRuntimeProvisioner.workerProcess()` — the single chokepoint both spawn paths go through, immediately before `ProcessBuilder.start` — instead of `LocalRuntimeProviderFactory.create()` (where #17949 added it). `create()` creates nothing. On POSIX a missing directory is created **`rwx------`** (owner-private, matching `LocalRuntimeStore`'s convention); an existing directory is used as-is — the local attestation worker does not inspect its cwd's mode or canonicity. Other platforms use plain `createDirectories`.
- **Wiring-time diagnosis (F2)**: `create()` runs a **non-creating** `canCreateDirectory` check on the ephemeral branch and throws `IllegalStateException("Runtime Broker state directory is unavailable: <path>")` for an unusable path. The check walks with `NOFOLLOW_LINKS` (a dangling symlink is not an absent path — F4/R2-4) and requires write **and search** on the nearest existing ancestor; the provision-time ensure failure also carries the path.
- **Mode-aware preflight, delegated (F1/R2-1/R3-1/R3-2/R4-1)**: ephemeral mode WARNs "created at first Runtime spawn" for an absent creatable path and requires write **and search** on an existing directory, like the wiring guard. Durable mode **delegates to the same checks `create()` runs**: an existing directory goes through `requireRecoveryDirectoryOutsideWorkspaces` + `RuntimeStateFiles.validateDirectory` (canonical, process owner, exactly `rwx------`); an absent one needs a symlink-free path, a readable/writable/searchable parent (the store fsyncs it for READ), and a location outside the Workspace roots, then WARNs "created during Broker wiring". `run()` exits 1 only on FAIL, so the shipped `--check`/`start` path no longer refuses the deployment this change enables — and no longer certifies a path startup refuses.
- **Configuration reference sync**: `configuration-descriptions.json` (en+zh) and the regenerated reference pages describe both modes' creation timing, the **durable** canonical/owner-private requirement (the local worker enforces nothing on its cwd), and the preflight WARN semantics (round-3/4 notes).
- **Ordering-proof regression tests (F3)**: `LocalProcessRuntimeProvisionerStateDirectoryTest` starts a **real `node` child** (guarded by the package's `requireNode()`) that writes `spawn-marker.txt` relative to its working directory and asserts directory + marker after the failed provision — a failure-path ensure leaves no child and no marker. Plus an owner-private permission assertion and an occupied-path provision case asserting the named `IllegalStateException` in the cause chain. `LocalRuntimeProviderFactoryStateDirectoryTest` (18 cases) pins create() side-effect-freedom, the wiring-time named refusal, multi-segment ancestor walks, dangling/live symlinks, file-parent and non-writable/non-searchable-parent FAIL arms (with `detail()`), the durable delegation (pre-created `0755` FAIL + create() refusal, `0300` parent FAIL, workspace-root FAIL, symlinked paths FAIL, relative-path canonical consistency), and existing-directory search-bit parity.

## Why it's needed

#17949 fixed hosted provisioning (`ProcessBuilder.start` fails on a missing working directory, surfacing as `runtime_provision_failed` / opaque warm-turn timeouts) by eagerly creating the state directory in the factory's non-durable branch. That deterministically breaks `RuntimeProviderPluginsTest.builtinProvidersAreTrulyOptionalOnTheApplicationClasspath`, which pins `create()` + `close()` as side-effect-free, reddening the fast Java lane for every PR that merges current main — observed on #17917's run 44778263874 and re-verified by triage and /verify-pr rounds 1–2. Lazy creation at spawn preserves both invariants; the wiring-time and preflight changes make the enabled deployment actually startable through the shipped path, keep misconfigurations diagnosable at startup (including dangling mounts and permission shapes base refused), and create a missing directory with the durable store's owner-private convention.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

With JDK 21, from `packages/managed-agent-server`: `mvn -pl verification -am test -Dtest=RuntimeProviderPluginsTest,LocalProcessRuntimeProvisionerStateDirectoryTest,LocalRuntimeProviderFactoryStateDirectoryTest,ManagedRuntimeCapacityTest,RuntimeProviderMaintenanceTest,StaticRuntimeProviderFactoryTest` — all green. Mutation witnesses (all measured, sources restored byte-for-byte): M1 delete the spawn ensure / M2 ensure on the failure path → provisioner tests red; M3 eager factory ensure → plugins + factory tests red; M4 delete the create()-time refusal → factory occupied test red; M8 drop `isWritable` / M11 drop `isExecutable` → the corresponding permission cases red; M9 single-step ancestor walk → multi-segment case red; M10 unconditional WARN → file-parent + permission cases red; M12 mode-blind preflight → durable arms red; M13 follow symlinks → dangling case red; M14 default-permission creation → owner-private test red; M15 drop the durable symlink walk → both durable symlink cases red; M16 drop the preflight search-bit clause → existing-directory case red; M17 drop the store-validator delegation → 0755/symlink cases red; M18 drop parent readability → 0300 case red; M19 drop the workspace-root comparisons → workspaceCwd case red; M20 drop the absent-path symlink walk → durable symlink case red; M21 validate the raw relative path → relative-path case red.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-observable behavior change for correctly configured deployments (the directory is still created before any spawn, now owner-private). Local focused suite on the merged current-main tree at `4452106bef`: **31/31** across six classes (plugins 2/2, provisioner state-directory 3/3, factory state-directory 18/18, capacity 3/3, maintenance 2/2, static factory 3/3), BUILD SUCCESS, Checkstyle 0, Prettier clean on the docs/JSON. Mutation matrix M1–M4 (round 1), M8–M14 (round 2), M15/M16/M11-rekill (round 3), M17–M20 (round 4) and M21 (self-audit): all killed. No-node acceptance: with `node` removed from PATH the spawn tests report skipped (requireNode assumption), not failed. Base control (pre-fix): plugins test 1 failed / 2 at the `doesNotExist` assertion.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  N/A   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

JDK 21.0.9 + Maven 3.9.11 task-local repository; real `node` child for the spawn-ordering test; shadow-PATH run for the no-node acceptance.

## Risk & Scope

- Failure modes: an unusable ephemeral state path (occupied, dangling symlink, uncreatable ancestor) is refused at wiring time with `IllegalStateException` naming the directory (no side effect); a post-wiring race fails the provision with `RuntimeBrokerException(503, runtime_provision_failed)` whose cause is the named `IllegalStateException`. Preflight WARNs for absent-but-creatable paths (mode-specific wording) and FAILs for occupied/uncreatable paths.
- The ensure runs inside `lifecycle.lock()` / `store.locked()` — one idempotent `Files.createDirectories` per spawn attempt; the durable provisioning path is unchanged (its store creates the directory during wiring; preflight now reflects that contract).
- A pre-created durable state directory with group/other bits, a non-owner owner, or a non-canonical path is refused at startup by the store's own validation (now mirrored by preflight); an ephemeral pre-created directory is used as-is — the local worker does not inspect its cwd. The SSH/external bootstraps enforce their own owner-private/canonical checks for those providers.
- Residual contract boundaries: spawn-time creation applies `rwx------` to every missing ancestor (safe-by-default for a broker-private path; pre-create shared ancestors if needed); no real `upgrade start` end-to-end was run (preflight pinned at the factory layer).
- Not validated / out of scope: full H2/MySQL/RocketMQ/Hosted lanes and SpotBugs are left to CI; no real `upgrade start` end-to-end (preflight pinned at the factory layer); Windows/macOS not run locally (POSIX permission tests self-skip where unsupported).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: preflight `broker-state` for an absent-but-creatable directory changes FAIL → WARN (deployments previously refused now start; the directory is created at first spawn / during wiring per mode).

## Linked Issues

References #17949 (introduced the eager creation), #17917 (the PR whose fast-tier run surfaced the regression; closed as superseded by #17921), and #17921. No closing keywords.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

完成 local Runtime provisioner 的惰性状态目录修复，处理评审第 1–4 轮与验证 findings F1–F5：

- spawn 期创建：ensure 位于 LocalProcessRuntimeProvisioner.workerProcess()（两条 spawn 路径唯一咽喉点，紧邻 ProcessBuilder.start 前），取代工厂 create()（#17949 加入处）。create() 不创建任何东西。POSIX 上缺失目录以 rwx------（owner-private，同 LocalRuntimeStore 约定）创建；已存在目录原样使用——local attestation worker 不检查 cwd 的权限/规范性。其他平台 plain createDirectories。
- 装配期诊断（F2）：create() 非持久分支跑非创建式 canCreateDirectory 检查，不可用路径抛 IllegalStateException("Runtime Broker state directory is unavailable: <path>")。检查以 NOFOLLOW_LINKS 遍历（悬空 symlink 不是缺失路径——F4/R2-4），并要求最近存在祖先可写且可搜索；spawn 期 ensure 失败也带路径。
- 模式感知 preflight（委托，F1/R2-1/R3-1/R3-2/R4-1）：ephemeral 缺失可创建时 WARN "created at first Runtime spawn"，现有目录与装配守卫同要求写＋搜索。durable 委托 create() 所跑的同一组检查：现有目录经 requireRecoveryDirectoryOutsideWorkspaces＋RuntimeStateFiles.validateDirectory（规范、进程属主、恰 rwx------）；缺失目录需无 symlink 路径、可读/可写/可搜索父目录（store 以 READ fsync）、Workspace roots 之外，然后 WARN "created during Broker wiring"。run() 仅对 FAIL 退 1——shipped --check/start 不再拒绝本改动启用的部署，也不再认证启动会拒绝的路径。
- 配置参考同步：configuration-descriptions.json（en+zh）与再生成的参考页描述两模式创建时机、durable 的规范/owner-private 要求（local worker 不检查 cwd）、preflight WARN 语义（第 3/4 轮注记）。
- 顺序证明回归测试（F3）：LocalProcessRuntimeProvisionerStateDirectoryTest 启动真实 node 子进程（经本包 requireNode() 守卫）相对 cwd 写 spawn-marker.txt，失败 provision 后断言目录＋marker——failure-path ensure 无子进程无 marker。另含 owner-private 权限断言与占用路径 provision 用例（cause 链命名 IllegalStateException）。LocalRuntimeProviderFactoryStateDirectoryTest（18 例）钉住 create() 无副作用、装配期命名拒绝、多层祖先遍历、悬空/活 symlink、文件父级与不可写/不可搜索父级 FAIL 臂（含 detail()）、durable 委托（预创建 0755 FAIL＋create() 拒绝、0300 父 FAIL、workspace-root FAIL、symlink 路径 FAIL、相对路径 canonical 一致性）、现有目录搜索位对齐。

## 为什么需要

#17949 为修复 hosted provisioning（ProcessBuilder.start 在工作目录缺失时失败，表现为 runtime_provision_failed/不透明 warm-turn 超时）在工厂非持久分支即时建目录，确定性破坏 RuntimeProviderPluginsTest 的 create()+close() 无副作用不变量，使所有合入当前 main 的 PR 的 fast Java 车道红——见于 #17917 run 44778263874，triage 与 /verify-pr 第 1–2 轮复核。spawn 期惰性创建保住两个不变量；装配期与 preflight 改动使被启用的部署经 shipped 路径真正可启动，误配置（含悬空挂载与 base 曾拒绝的权限形状）在启动期可诊断，且缺失目录以 durable store 的仅属主约定创建。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

JDK 21 下于 packages/managed-agent-server：mvn -pl verification -am test -Dtest=RuntimeProviderPluginsTest,LocalProcessRuntimeProvisionerStateDirectoryTest,LocalRuntimeProviderFactoryStateDirectoryTest,ManagedRuntimeCapacityTest,RuntimeProviderMaintenanceTest,StaticRuntimeProviderFactoryTest 全绿。变异见证（均实测、字节级还原）：M1 去 spawn ensure／M2 failure-path ensure→provisioner 测试红；M3 工厂即时 ensure→plugins＋工厂红；M4 去 create 期拒绝→工厂占用测试红；M8 去 isWritable／M11 去 isExecutable→对应权限用例红；M9 单步祖先遍历→多层用例红；M10 无条件 WARN→文件父级＋权限用例红；M12 模式盲 preflight→durable 双臂红；M13 跟随 symlink→悬空用例红；M14 默认权限创建→owner-private 测试红；M15 去 durable symlink 遍历→durable 双 symlink 用例红；M16 去 preflight 搜索位子句→现有目录用例红；M17 去 store 校验委托→0755/symlink 用例红；M18 去父可读→0300 用例红；M19 去 workspace-root 比较→workspaceCwd 用例红；M20 去缺失路径 symlink 遍历→durable symlink 用例红；M21 校验原始相对路径→相对路径用例红。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A——正确配置部署无用户可见行为变化（目录仍在任何 spawn 前创建，现为 owner-private）。4452106bef 合并当前 main 树本地聚焦套件：六类 31/31（plugins 2/2、provisioner 状态目录 3/3、工厂状态目录 18/18、容量 3/3、维护 2/2、static 工厂 3/3）、BUILD SUCCESS、Checkstyle 0、docs/JSON Prettier 净。变异矩阵 M1–M4（第 1 轮）、M8–M14（第 2 轮）、M15/M16/M11 复杀（第 3 轮）、M17–M20（第 4 轮）与 M21（自审）全杀。无 node 验收：PATH 剔除 node 后 spawn 测试报 skipped（requireNode assumption）而非 fail。base 对照（修复前）：plugins 测试 1 failed / 2（doesNotExist 断言）。

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | N/A |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ |

### 环境（可选）

JDK 21.0.9 + Maven 3.9.11 任务隔离仓库；spawn 顺序测试用真实 node 子进程；无 node 验收用影子 PATH。

## 风险与范围

- 失败形态：不可用临时状态路径（占用、悬空 symlink、不可创建祖先）装配期以命名目录的 IllegalStateException 拒绝（无副作用）；装配后竞态使 provision 以 RuntimeBrokerException(503, runtime_provision_failed) 失败，cause 为命名 IllegalStateException。preflight 对缺失但可创建判 WARN（按模式区分文案）、占用/不可创建判 FAIL。
- ensure 在 lifecycle.lock()/store.locked() 内执行——每次 spawn 尝试一个幂等 Files.createDirectories；durable provisioning 路径不变（其 store 装配期建目录；preflight 现反映该契约）。
- 预创建的 durable 状态目录若带组/其他位、非属主所有或非规范路径，启动期被 store 自身校验拒绝（preflight 现已镜像）；ephemeral 预创建目录原样使用——local worker 不检查 cwd。SSH/external bootstrap 对各自 provider 执行其 owner-private/规范检查。
- 残余契约边界：spawn 期创建对每个缺失祖先施加 rwx------（broker 私有路径的安全默认；需要共享祖先时预创建）；未跑真实 upgrade start 端到端（preflight 钉在工厂层）。
- 未验证/范围外：完整 H2/MySQL/RocketMQ/Hosted 车道与 SpotBugs 留 CI；无真实 upgrade start 端到端（preflight 钉在工厂层）；Windows/macOS 未本地跑（POSIX 权限测试在不支持处自跳过）。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：preflight broker-state 对缺失但可创建目录由 FAIL 改 WARN（此前被拒的部署现在可启动；目录按模式在首次 spawn/装配期创建）。

## 关联 Issue

引用 #17949（引入即时创建）、#17917（其 fast-tier run 暴露回归；已以被 #17921 取代关闭）、#17921。不使用关闭关键词。

prs.title: feat(i18n): add Arabic support for CLI and Web Shell with RTL layout
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This pull request adds complete Arabic language support across both the command-line interface and the Web Shell, including right-to-left layout support in the Web Shell and exported HTML transcripts.

In core and the CLI, Arabic is registered as a shipped language option in the shared output language table and settings schema so it appears alongside existing locales in interactive language selection, slash-command completions, daemon feature advertisement, ACP integrations, and automated locale checks. A full Arabic locale catalog is included for CLI prompts, commands, tool display names, and subscription quota notices with all six Arabic cardinal plural forms.

In the Web Shell, Arabic is supported across transcript views, standalone gates, Managed agent views, slash-command subcommand completion, local command hints, toast notices, settings dialogs, and the service-worker offline fallback. Right-to-left rendering is driven automatically from the resolved UI language via document and portal direction attributes, Radix direction context propagation, conversion of layout-directional CSS and Tailwind utilities to logical properties, mirrored pointer-drag resize deltas and horizontal arrow-key navigation, flipped directional chevrons and back arrows, RTL-aware sticky DataTable pinning and Switch thumb travel, and explicit left-to-right preservation for code blocks, diffs, terminals, structured spreadsheets, charts, left-to-right plan dependency topology graphs, and interactive waiting games. Interactive-only Arabic translations are stubbed out of the read-only transcript export bundle while keeping transcript-reachable Arabic strings available in exported HTML documents, and the document export bundle budget has been updated to match the measured size.

## Why it's needed

Arabic-speaking users previously had to fall back to English in both the terminal CLI and the browser Web Shell, and Arabic text inside the Web Shell rendered inside an English left-to-right shell chrome with unmirrored spacing, borders, popovers, drawers, and directional controls. Adding full Arabic catalogs, CLDR six-form pluralization, and full RTL layout mirroring makes both interfaces natural and usable for Arabic users without inflating read-only exported HTML transcripts with interactive-only UI strings.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Switch the CLI UI language to Arabic via settings or `/language ui ar`, and verify locale normalization for regional and POSIX variants such as `ar-SA` and `ar_EG.UTF-8` while confirming unrelated prefix neighbors like `armenian` do not map to Arabic. Confirm CLI menus, `/language` choices, tool display badges, and multi-form quota messages render in Arabic, and model output language settings recognize `Arabic` alongside existing options.
2. Open the Web Shell in standalone or embedded mode with Arabic selected via `?language=ar`, `/language ui ar`, `/settings`, or browser locale, and verify both the root container and the portal root carry `lang="ar"` and `dir="rtl"`.
3. Inspect key RTL surfaces in Web Shell: the sidebar docks on the start side and widens when dragging its resize handle leftward, popovers and tooltips open on the mirrored side, the floating artifact drawer slides from the left edge, the docked right panel widens when dragging its divider rightward, horizontal tab and timeline arrow navigation follows RTL order, directional back arrows and collapsed chevrons mirror visually, switches slide leftward when toggled on, and DataTable sticky leading/trailing columns pin to the right and left edges respectively.
4. Confirm code blocks, diffs, terminals, spreadsheets, ECharts, and left-to-right DAG plan dependency graphs remain legible with intentional left-to-right structural geometry while user messages isolate mixed-direction text cleanly.
5. Export a conversation to HTML while using Arabic and verify exported transcripts render localized status labels and RTL direction without pulling interactive-only Arabic dictionaries into the read-only transcript bundle.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Automated verification after the final edits confirmed green workspace builds, TypeScript typechecks across all packages and integration tests, zero-warning strict linting, CLI i18n checks showing 1976/2005 Arabic keys translated with zero missing keys, clean read-only transcript bundle builds within the updated byte ceiling, and passing unit/DOM tests covering core output-language consumers, CLI language/quota behavior, Web Shell Arabic pluralization, non-collision locale normalization, build-boundary separation, and RTL layout/resize/drawer/table behavior. Live browser screenshots were not captured locally in this turn.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local Node 22 macOS verification covering workspace builds, strict ESLint, TypeScript typechecks, Prettier formatting, CLI locale validation, and Vitest unit/DOM suites. Playwright browser E2E, integration suites, and Windows/Linux hosts remain to be validated in CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Adding Arabic to the shared core output-language table affects downstream consumers across core goal verification, session title generation, the settings JSON schema, the CLI language registry and `/language` command, serve settings/feature routes, ACP integration, and the i18n check script; all downstream consumers were verified against the build, typecheck, and existing/expanded unit tests. In Web Shell, keeping synchronous translator lookups splits Arabic strings into transcript-reachable and interactive-only modules so read-only HTML exports grow by 47,120 measured bytes (including RTL runtime wiring) rather than carrying all interactive copy. Broad logical CSS/Tailwind refactoring across Web Shell components relies on automated CSS, ref-compat, and DOM suites locally and benefits from Playwright/visual spot-checks in CI.
- Not validated / out of scope: VS Code IDE companion host-chrome strings outside the embedded Web Shell remain English and Simplified Chinese only and were left untouched as requested scope focused on CLI and Web Shell; terminal RTL rendering behavior depends on the host terminal emulator; full Playwright visual tests and non-macOS runners were not executed locally; an unrelated pre-existing timing race observed in the Managed local-files bridge test suite also reproduces identically on the untouched base commit.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None. English remains the fallback locale, existing partial-catalog behavior for Russian is unchanged, and existing language configuration values continue to work without migration.

## Linked Issues

None

## 本 PR 做了什么

本 PR 为命令行界面（CLI）与 Web Shell 增加了完整的阿拉伯语语言支持，并在 Web Shell 及导出的 HTML 对话记录中支持从右到左（RTL）的镜像布局。

在 Core 与 CLI 部分，我们将阿拉伯语注册为共享输出语言表及设置 Schema 中的内置语言选项，使其能够同步出现在交互式语言选择器、斜杠命令补全、守护进程特性声明、ACP 集成以及国际化校验脚本中。同时新增了完整的 CLI 阿拉伯语翻译词典，覆盖交互提示、命令说明、工具显示名称以及包含全部六种阿拉伯语基数复数形态的订阅配额提示。

在 Web Shell 部分，阿拉伯语已全面覆盖对话记录视图、独立认证门槛页、托管 Agent 视图、斜杠命令子命令补全、本地命令提示、Toast 通知、设置面板以及 Service Worker 离线回退页。系统会根据解析出的界面语言自动在根容器与 Portal 根节点设置 `lang="ar"` 与 `dir="rtl"`，并通过 Radix 方向上下文向下透传；同时将具备方向语义的 CSS 与 Tailwind 样式统一改造为逻辑属性，在 RTL 模式下镜像处理侧边栏与右侧面板拖拽调整宽度的方向符号、横向键盘方向键导航、返回箭头与折叠尖角图标方向、Switch 开关滑块位移动画以及 DataTable 固定列的吸顶方向；对于代码块、Diff、终端、电子表格、图表、有向无环计划拓扑图和等待小游戏等需要保持物理从左到右结构的内容，则显式保留 LTR 排版，并对混合方向的用户消息采用双向隔离渲染。为避免导出体积膨胀，仅交互界面使用的阿拉伯语词条会在导出 HTML 构建模式中被独立存根剔除，仅保留只读记录所需词条，并依据实测字节数同步更新了导出运行时大小预算。

## 为什么需要这个改动

此前使用阿拉伯语的用户在 CLI 与 Web Shell 中只能回退到英文界面，且 Web Shell 中的阿拉伯语文本会直接嵌入英文 LTR 界面框架里，导致边距、边框、弹出层方向、抽屉滑出方向以及箭头图标方向均与阿拉伯语阅读习惯相反。通过补充完整的阿拉伯语词条、CLDR 六形态复数规则以及全套 RTL 镜像布局，两个端都可以为阿拉伯语用户提供自然完整的使用体验，同时保证只读导出的 HTML 文件不会被仅用于交互界面的翻译文本拖累体积。

## 审阅测试计划

### 验证方式

1. 在 CLI 中通过配置文件或 `/language ui ar` 切换界面语言为阿拉伯语，并验证 `ar-SA`、`ar_EG.UTF-8` 等区域/POSIX 标签的规范化解析，同时确认诸如 `armenian` 等共享前缀但不相干的词不会被误识别为阿拉伯语。检查 CLI 菜单、`/language` 选项、工具名称徽章、订阅配额多复数形式以及模型输出语言 `Arabic` 的显示与设置是否正常。
2. 在独立模式或嵌入模式下通过 `?language=ar`、`/language ui ar`、`/settings` 或浏览器语言切换到阿拉伯语打开 Web Shell，确认主根节点和 Portal 根节点均带有 `lang="ar"` 和 `dir="rtl"` 属性。
3. 验证 Web Shell 中的核心 RTL 交互与布局：侧边栏停靠在起始侧且向左拖拽分隔条时加宽，Tooltip 与 Popover 在镜像侧弹出，窄屏下的浮动右侧抽屉从左侧滑入，宽屏停靠下的右侧面板向右拖拽分隔条时加宽，水平 Tab 与时间轴导航遵循 RTL 方向键顺序，返回箭头和折叠箭头图标完成水平镜像，Switch 在开启时向左滑动，DataTable 固定首列与操作尾列分别吸附在右侧和左侧边缘。
4. 确认代码块、Diff 视图、终端、电子表格、ECharts 图表以及计划 DAG 拓扑图依然保持清晰的从左到右结构方向，同时包含阿英混排的用户消息可正确自动隔离文本方向。
5. 在阿拉伯语环境下导出 HTML 对话记录，确认导出文档可正确呈现本地化状态文案与 RTL 排版，且仅交互场景使用的阿拉伯语词典未被打包进只读导出产物。

### 对比证据

在最终修改完成后，我们已完成全仓工作区构建、全量 TypeScript 类型检查、零警告严格 ESLint 检查、Prettier 格式化校验、CLI 国际化脚本校验（阿拉伯语共翻译 1976/2005 项，缺失关键项为 0）、导出 HTML 运行时体积校验以及核心模块、CLI、Web Shell 与 VS Code Companion 相关单测和 DOM 测试验证。本次在本地未额外截取实时浏览器界面截图。

### 测试环境

|     系统   | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 运行环境说明

基于本地 macOS 与 Node 22 环境完成了工作区构建、严格 ESLint 检查、TypeScript 类型检查、Prettier 格式检查、CLI 语言校验与 Vitest 单元/DOM 测试；Playwright 浏览器 E2E 测试、集成测试及 Windows/Linux 环境需由 CI 进一步验证。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：在核心公共输出语言表中新增阿拉伯语会影响目标校验、会话标题生成、设置 JSON Schema、CLI 语言注册及 `/language` 命令、daemon 设置与特性路由、ACP 集成以及 i18n 检查脚本等下游消费方；上述全部下游消费方均已通过构建、类型检查以及原有与新增单测的验证。在 Web Shell 中，为保持同步翻译读取契约，我们将阿拉伯语词条拆分为只读记录与交互界面两个模块，使导出 HTML 运行时资产实测净增 47,120 字节（包含 RTL 方向控制逻辑）而不会引入大批量交互文案。组件库及各页面级样式大量改造为 CSS 逻辑属性与 RTL 镜像规则后，本地已通过 CSS 规则、ref 兼容与 DOM 单测验证，建议 CI 中结合视觉回归进一步复核。
- 未验证 / 范围之外：VS Code 扩展宿主侧外部框架文案未在本次范围内，仍维持英文与简体中文（其中嵌入的 Web Shell 本体支持阿拉伯语和 RTL）；终端层面的双向文字排布效果取决于用户所用的终端模拟器本身；全量 Playwright 视觉测试及非 macOS 平台尚未在本地运行；在 Web Shell 全量测试运行中观察到的 Managed 本地文件桥接测试条目存在一处上游基线提交已引入的无关竞态失败（我们的改动未涉及该目录）。

prs.title: feat: add hybrid code mode
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a Codex-aligned `tools.mode` enum with `direct`, `code_mode`, and `code_mode_only`. `code_mode` keeps ordinary tools directly callable while also exposing the isolated `exec` JavaScript tool; each visible ordinary tool carries its nested JavaScript declaration, while `exec` retains compact `ALL_TOOLS` metadata. `code_mode_only` preserves the strict exec-only ordinary-tool surface, and `direct` remains the default.

Updates filtered subagent tool surfaces so direct declarations and nested exec bindings honor the same allowlists, exposes the enum in Settings as Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only, regenerates the settings JSON schema, and removes the former `tools.codeModeOnly` boolean setting entirely.

Adds synchronized [English](docs/design/code-mode.md) and [Chinese](docs/design/code-mode.zh-CN.md) design documents, and brings the existing CodeModeOnly design up to the repository's bilingual documentation standard ([English](docs/design/code-mode-only.md), [Chinese](docs/design/code-mode-only.zh-CN.md)).

## Why it's needed

Qwen Code previously offered only the default direct tool surface or the strict CodeModeOnly surface. Models could not combine direct calls for simple operations with `exec` orchestration for multi-tool workflows. A three-value enum matches Codex's `ToolMode` naming and gives users one explicit setting for all supported exposure modes.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Leave `tools.mode` unset or set it to `direct`, restart Qwen Code, and confirm ordinary tools remain available while `exec` is absent.
2. Set `tools.mode` to `code_mode`, restart, and confirm both ordinary tools and `exec` are available. Confirm ordinary tool descriptions include their `tools.<name>(args)` declaration and deferred tools remain discoverable through `tool_search`.
3. Set `tools.mode` to `code_mode_only`, restart, and confirm ordinary tools are available through `exec` rather than as top-level calls, while direct control tools remain available.
4. Open Settings and confirm Tool Mode cycles among Default, Code Mode, and Code Mode Only. Confirm `tools.codeModeOnly` is no longer present in the settings schema.
5. Start with `--safe-mode` or `--bare` while either code mode is configured and confirm the effective mode is `direct`.

Automated verification completed: focused Core tests (121 tests), focused CLI tests (585 tests), a repeated settings-schema regression run (60 tests), full build, full typecheck, full lint, and both installed and branch-built CLI version smoke checks.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: Settings exposed `Code Mode Only (Experimental)` as a boolean with `false` / `true`.

After: Settings exposes `Tool Mode (Experimental)` as an enum displaying Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only. Updated TUI snapshots cover the default display.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

macOS, Node.js v24.18.0; local source build and package-level Vitest suites.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Hybrid mode adds a short nested-call declaration to each ordinary tool description, increasing prompt size slightly; complete schemas are not duplicated in the `exec` description.
- Not validated / out of scope: Live-provider interactive runs and Windows/Linux local execution were not tested; CI covers supported platforms.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: `tools.codeModeOnly` is removed. Replace `{ "tools": { "codeModeOnly": true } }` with `{ "tools": { "mode": "code_mode_only" } }`.

## Linked Issues

Related to #10377.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

新增与 Codex 对齐的 `tools.mode` 枚举，支持 `direct`、`code_mode` 和 `code_mode_only`。`code_mode` 在保留普通工具直接调用能力的同时提供隔离的 `exec` JavaScript 工具；每个可见普通工具会携带自己的嵌套 JavaScript 声明，而 `exec` 保留精简的 `ALL_TOOLS` 元数据。`code_mode_only` 保持严格的普通工具仅经 `exec` 调用模式，`direct` 仍为默认值。

更新经过过滤的子智能体工具面，使直接声明和 `exec` 嵌套 binding 遵守同一组 allowlist；在设置界面中将该枚举显示为 Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only；重新生成 settings JSON schema；并彻底移除原来的 `tools.codeModeOnly` 布尔设置。

新增同步的[英文](docs/design/code-mode.md)和[中文](docs/design/code-mode.zh-CN.md)设计文档，并将现有 CodeModeOnly 设计补齐为仓库要求的双语文档（[英文](docs/design/code-mode-only.md)、[中文](docs/design/code-mode-only.zh-CN.md)）。

## 为什么需要

Qwen Code 此前只提供默认的直接工具面或严格的 CodeModeOnly 工具面。模型无法在简单操作中使用直接调用，同时在多工具工作流中使用 `exec` 编排。三值枚举与 Codex 的 `ToolMode` 命名一致，并为所有支持的暴露模式提供一个明确的统一设置项。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 不设置 `tools.mode` 或将其设为 `direct`，重启 Qwen Code，确认普通工具仍可用且不存在 `exec`。
2. 将 `tools.mode` 设为 `code_mode` 并重启，确认普通工具和 `exec` 同时可用；确认普通工具描述包含各自的 `tools.<name>(args)` 声明，延迟工具仍可通过 `tool_search` 发现。
3. 将 `tools.mode` 设为 `code_mode_only` 并重启，确认普通工具通过 `exec` 而不是顶层调用使用，同时直接控制工具仍然可用。
4. 打开设置界面，确认 Tool Mode 可在 Default、Code Mode 和 Code Mode Only 之间切换，并确认 settings schema 中不再存在 `tools.codeModeOnly`。
5. 配置任一 code mode 后用 `--safe-mode` 或 `--bare` 启动，确认有效模式为 `direct`。

已完成自动化验证：Core 相关测试（121 个）、CLI 相关测试（585 个）、再次运行的 settings schema 回归测试（60 个）、完整 build、完整 typecheck、完整 lint，以及已安装版本和分支构建版本的 CLI 版本 smoke 检查。

### 前后对比证据

之前：设置界面以 `false` / `true` 布尔值展示 `Code Mode Only (Experimental)`。

之后：设置界面以枚举展示 `Tool Mode (Experimental)`，可选 Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only。更新后的 TUI snapshot 覆盖默认显示。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

macOS、Node.js v24.18.0；本地源码构建和 package 级 Vitest 测试套件。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：混合模式会在每个普通工具描述中增加一段简短的嵌套调用声明，使 prompt 略微增大；完整 schema 不会在 `exec` 描述中重复。
- 未验证 / 范围外：未进行真实 provider 的交互式运行，也未在 Windows/Linux 本地执行；支持平台由 CI 覆盖。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：`tools.codeModeOnly` 已移除。请将 `{ "tools": { "codeModeOnly": true } }` 替换为 `{ "tools": { "mode": "code_mode_only" } }`。

## 关联 Issue

关联 #10377。

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): compact automatic trigger messages
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Repetitive cron and self-paced `/loop` continuations now appear as compact automatic-trigger cards rather than full-sized ordinary user bubbles. The card shows a concise summary of the transcript-provided text and reveals all available detailed text through the existing Show more/Collapse disclosure. Rich content is evaluated only when needed, and known short Loop tick echoes stay as static summaries instead of offering a redundant expansion. Ordinary user input and structured per-run scheduled-task messages retain their previous presentation, including existing message-routing labels and the outer timestamp.

## Why it's needed

Long wakeup prompts can recur many times in one session. Repeating hundreds of characters in standard user bubbles makes the conversation difficult to scan and makes system-generated turns look as though the user typed them manually. Compact cards make the transcript easier to follow while preserving the complete displayed instructions for inspection.

The implementation also updates the measured document-export limit to 2,152,000 bytes. The final renderer measures 2,151,571 bytes, retaining a 429-byte margin instead of either raising the cap arbitrarily or leaving only 6 bytes of headroom.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open a transcript with cron input, self-paced Loop input, ordinary user input, and a structured per-run scheduled task. Confirm that the automatic inputs render as compact cards with the appropriate `cron` and `loop` source attribution, while the ordinary message and structured task retain their previous presentation.
2. Activate **Show more**. Confirm that the expanded content preserves the complete displayed prompt, its line breaks, external links, and slash-command highlighting. Activate **Collapse** to restore the summary.
3. Repeat at desktop (1440×900) and mobile (390×844) widths and confirm that there is no horizontal overflow. A short ordinary automatic prompt must keep its detail control; only the recognized `Autonomous loop tick` and `Loop tick — …` echoes suppress the redundant disclosure.
4. Start editing the latest automatic message, verify that the editor contains the unabridged original text, and cancel. The compact card should return unchanged.
5. Check static document output. Detailed text is expanded by default with no interactive disclosure, and closed interactive cards do not invoke the host renderer or default rich-content parser before expansion.
6. Confirm the final document-export measurement of 2,151,571 bytes against the measured 2,152,000-byte budget.

Local checks completed on Linux with Node v26.12.1:

- Three focused Vitest files: **360 tests passed** (90 `UserMessage`, 25 `MessageItem.dom`, 245 `transcriptToMessages`).
- Web Shell `lint`, `format:check`, and `typecheck`: all passed.
- Repository `build`, `typecheck`, and `bundle`: all completed successfully; the VS Code workspace retained its pre-existing 30 warnings with zero errors.
- The automatic-trigger Playwright spec passed **2/2** against Vite and **2/2** against the final `node dist/cli.js` serve artifact, with no skipped, unexpected, or flaky results.

### Evidence (Before & After)

**Before — a long automatic continuation rendered as an ordinary user bubble (mobile):**

![Before: a long automatic prompt occupies a full ordinary user bubble on mobile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/automatic-trigger-message/automatic-trigger-before-mobile.png)

**After — two automatic continuations appear as compact cards (desktop):**

![After: cron and loop inputs are compact automatic-trigger cards on desktop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/automatic-trigger-message/automatic-trigger-desktop.png)

**After — the original detailed text remains available on mobile:**

![After: the mobile card expands to show the complete multiline continuation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/automatic-trigger-message/automatic-trigger-mobile-expanded.png)

These images were captured through the automatic-trigger Playwright scenario, from the global 0.28.0 baseline and from the final `node dist/cli.js` build respectively. They show the actual UI rather than a mockup.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Local Vite plus the final `node dist/cli.js serve` artifact on isolated loopback ports, headless Playwright Chromium, and a mocked daemon transcript. No shared daemon was restarted, and no live model calls were made.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Longer automatic prompts now require one deliberate disclosure action. Recognized short loop echoes intentionally provide no expansion because the UI only receives their label, not full `modelText`. The timestamp retains the existing projection/execution semantics; this PR does not claim that it represents the actual scheduled fire time.
- Not validated / out of scope: No native macOS or Windows run, no WebKit run, and no full workspace test matrix or attempt to group repeated ticks into a stable loop chain. This is not a full-model-input audit surface.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: No change to `modelText`, scheduling, cancellation, persistence, replay payloads, or daemon APIs. The document-export limit rises from 2,151,577 to 2,152,000 bytes based on the current measurement, leaving 429 bytes of local margin. English and Simplified Chinese labels are included; other languages retain their normal fallback.

Design documents: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/d4fde87a2feba5f5a6566b592b717c3a67f88eb8/docs/design/2026-11-20-web-shell-automatic-trigger-message.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/d4fde87a2feba5f5a6566b592b717c3a67f88eb8/docs/design/2026-11-20-web-shell-automatic-trigger-message.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Related: #17267 — that issue tracks pending-wakeup visibility, while this PR changes the display of already-fired automatic inputs. It is not being closed by this PR.
