prs.title: feat(web-shell): accept follow-up suggestions on touch composers
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a touch acceptance path for follow-up suggestions in the Web Shell composer. On phones and tablets the composer is the plain-textarea backend, where a suggestion previously appeared only as dimmed placeholder text: tapping Send with an empty input submitted it directly, and typing a prefix then sending completed it, but nothing let the user put the suggestion into the input and edit it before sending, the way desktop Tab, Enter and Right Arrow do. This change adds a single touch accept surface: a chip-styled tappable bar above the input row in every composer variant, whose label is the suggestion text itself with an insert icon, plus a dismiss button; the editing row carries no follow-up key. Tapping the chip fills the textarea: the composer's outer click handler focuses it synchronously inside the tap gesture, then the host's accept defers the insert by a microtask and re-requests focus, so on real iOS the deferred focus request may land outside the tap gesture and the soft keyboard may not open (real-iOS keyboard behavior remains unverified). The user is free to edit before sending; the dismiss button stops click propagation so dismissing never pulls focus into the input, and keeps the existing ignored-outcome telemetry. The chip hides as soon as the user types. While the chip is visible the input keeps its ordinary placeholder, so the suggestion text appears on exactly one surface instead of being duplicated between bar and placeholder; the full-screen expanded editor is the one exception — with the dialog open and an empty draft, its textarea carries the suggestion as placeholder and aria-label so the suggestion never disappears from every surface. The two existing fast paths are unchanged: Send with an empty input still submits the visible suggestion, and a typed prefix still completes on send. The default touch layout's editing row also gains four always-live keys on its trailing side: up/down move the caret between the displayed lines (soft-wrapped visual lines measured only around the caret with one cached mirror per textarea, removed on replacement and discarded on clear/unmount — no full-draft re-measurement and no hidden-node accumulation on long drafts, horizontal moves skip measurement entirely; grapheme-safe steps and clamps including the whole final grapheme of a wrapped line and zero-length empty next lines; preferred column held only across a vertical run and the landed displayed line anchoring the next press, so repeated Up crosses a wrap boundary like native; long drafts scrolled to keep the caret visible), right moves one grapheme or accepts the visible suggestion only when there is still text to add (desktop Right Arrow parity; an exact-match draft just moves the caret), and slash inserts a literal slash; they pause during IME composition and add no new vertical row. User documentation gains a touch-devices section, and a bilingual design doc records the decision and its history.

## Why it's needed

Follow-up suggestions predict the next prompt after a clean turn, and on desktop accepting one is a fill-don't-submit gesture so a suggested slash command never auto-executes. Touch users had no equivalent: they could only send the prediction blind or retype it by hand, which defeats the purpose of showing it. The mobile composer once carried simulated Tab/Esc/arrow keys, removed because Tab did nothing on the textarea backend, and later lost its up/down history stepping because the history search panel is the better touch recall path. Now that suggestions give acceptance a real job on touch, the chip offers the same fill-don't-submit gesture without reviving a dead key or naming hardware: it renders only while a suggestion is visible, and the old "no simulated keyboard keys without a suggestion" acceptance still holds. Earlier revisions paired the bar with an editing-row key (first labelled Tab, then the action word Fill in); review showed a detached verb label still costs comprehension, so the final design keeps only the content-labelled chip. History stepping is deliberately not revived, since a plain textarea restore cannot rebuild inline tag chips.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Open the Web Shell on a touch device, or emulate one (Playwright's Pixel 7 / iPhone profiles, or DevTools device mode; `?composer=textarea` forces the backend on desktop). Let a turn finish cleanly so the daemon pushes a suggestion, or drive the mock daemon as the new E2E spec does. With an empty input, confirm the suggestion appears as a tappable bar above the input while the input keeps its ordinary placeholder; the editing row shows no follow-up key in either variant. Tap the chip: the text lands in the input, the keyboard opens, nothing is submitted, and both touch points disappear; edit the text and send it yourself. Tap the bar's dismiss button instead: the suggestion bar disappears and Send becomes disabled. With an empty input tap Send directly: the whole suggestion is submitted as the message. Type a prefix of the suggestion and tap Send: the completed suggestion is submitted. Type anything else: the bar hides and Send submits exactly what was typed. With a multi-line draft, tap up/down/right and confirm the caret moves between the lines you see (column kept across short lines, clamped at document edges, long drafts scrolled into view); type 150 unbroken characters and confirm up/down land on the same carets as the native arrow keys; with an emoji draft confirm right steps over the whole emoji, up to a wrapped line end keeps it whole, and slash never splits it; tap down onto an empty next line and keep moving; tap up repeatedly across a wrap boundary and confirm it matches native arrows; tap right then down and confirm the column follows the new caret; type and tap right ten times and confirm no hidden measurement nodes accumulate; with a 50k draft confirm the keys answer instantly; with a visible suggestion tap right and confirm it fills without submitting, while a draft already equal to the suggestion just moves the caret; tap slash and confirm a literal '/' lands; open the expanded editor with an empty draft and confirm the suggestion is its placeholder; dismiss from an unfocused composer and confirm the keyboard control never appears. Automated coverage: `cd packages/web-shell && PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=<free port> npx playwright test --project=mobile-chromium web-shell.followup.mobile.spec.ts` (twenty-seven cases, all of the above plus empty-next and wrap-anchor moves, mirror lifecycle, 18px icon geometry, key-latency on a 50k draft, IME composition via CDP and the zh-CN UI; 25 tagged @smoke so they run in the PR-gating smoke job on both engines) and `npx vitest run client/utils/touchCaret.test.ts client/App.css.test.ts client/hooks/useComposerCore.test.ts client/hooks/useComposerCore.mobile.dom.test.tsx client/components/ChatEditor.test.tsx client/i18n.test.ts` (unit tests pin visibility across draft/hidden/desktop/disabled/simple-variant states, the accept/dismiss and editing-key wiring, composition and selection-reset wiring, the dynamic right-key label, the exact-match accept gate, the held column and its user-jump reset and horizontal-move recompute, scroll reveal, and the grapheme/visual-line caret math including selection-head and wrap-end edges; accept never submits).

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: on the touch backend the suggestion existed only as placeholder text; there was no bar, no fill key and no dismiss control in the DOM (structural absence on main, verified by reading the touch branch and by the pre-change E2E baseline where the only acceptance was Send-with-empty-input). After, captured under Pixel 7 touch emulation with the mock daemon pushing `run the tests`:

Simple variant — chip bar with dismiss above the input row, the input keeping its ordinary placeholder (single surface), Send enabled:

![Simple variant suggestion bar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/mobile-followup-acceptance/followup-bar-simple-v4.png)

Default variant — the chip bar above the input with the ordinary placeholder, and an editing row whose trailing keys are caret/slash keys only (no follow-up-specific key); both default-variant shots share one unfocused state, so the conditional hide-keyboard control is absent:

![Default variant chip bar and caret keys](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/mobile-followup-acceptance/followup-keys-row-v6.png)

Simplified Chinese UI (`zh-CN`, suggestion 运行测试) — the chip bar with the localized dismiss label in both variants; the editing row carries no follow-up key and the input keeps its ordinary Chinese placeholder:

![Simplified Chinese simple variant bar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/mobile-followup-acceptance/followup-bar-simple-zh-v2.png)

![Simplified Chinese default variant chip bar and caret keys](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/mobile-followup-acceptance/followup-keys-row-zh-v6.png)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Linux verification uses Chromium touch emulation (mobile-chromium project); the mobile-webkit project and real iOS/Android devices were not exercised on this host (missing WebKit runtime libraries), so soft-keyboard-open layout pressure from the extra 44px row remains unmeasured on real hardware.

### Environment (optional)

Playwright-managed Vite dev server (`npm run dev`, source aliases for the SDK and daemon-react-sdk), Pixel 7 device emulation, mock daemon per page; jsdom unit tests run with `NODE_OPTIONS=--no-experimental-webstorage` on Node 26 to avoid the host's native localStorage placeholder shadowing jsdom.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: while a suggestion is visible the bar adds one 44px row above the input; with a soft keyboard open on a short viewport this competes with the attachments strip for room. Idle layout is unchanged because the bar only renders with a visible suggestion and an empty draft.
- Not validated / out of scope: real iOS/WebKit keyboard behavior, iPad hardware-keyboard Tab/Right acceptance (deferred follow-up), and soft-keyboard-open layout measurement; history stepping stays removed by design.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No public API or daemon contract changes; six new i18n keys per catalog (English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Russian).

Design doc: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-mobile-followup-acceptance/docs/design/web-shell/web-shell-mobile-followup-acceptance.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-mobile-followup-acceptance/docs/design/web-shell/web-shell-mobile-followup-acceptance.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

No tracking issue; the feature was requested directly in review of the touch composer's follow-up gap.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

为 Web Shell 输入框的 follow-up suggestion 增加触摸接受路径。手机与平板上输入框是原生 textarea 后端,建议此前只以弱化 placeholder 灰字出现:空输入点发送会整条直发,输入前缀再发送会补全直发,但用户无法像桌面 Tab / Enter / → 那样把建议填进输入框先编辑再发送。本变更新增单一触摸接受面:覆盖所有 composer 变体的、输入行上方的 chip 样式可点按建议条,标签即建议文本本身并带插入图标,旁带忽略按钮;编辑行不带 follow-up 键。点按 chip 会填入 textarea:composer 外层点击处理先在手势内同步聚焦,宿主 accept 再经 microtask 延迟插入并再次请求 focus,故真 iOS 上延迟的 focus 请求可能落在 tap 手势之外、软键盘可能不弹(真 iOS 键盘行为仍未验证)。用户可编辑后再自行发送;忽略按钮阻止点击冒泡,忽略不会把焦点拉进输入框,并保留既有 ignored 遥测。chip 在用户开始打字后即隐藏。建议条可见时输入框保持普通占位符,建议文字只出现在一个 surface 上,不在建议条与 placeholder 之间重复;全屏展开编辑器是唯一例外——对话框打开且草稿为空时,由其 textarea 的 placeholder 与 aria-label 承载建议,保证建议不会在所有 surface 上消失。两条既有快路径不变:空输入点发送仍整条直发,已输入前缀仍在发送时补全。default 触摸布局的编辑行尾侧另加四个始终有活功能的键:上/下在屏幕显示的行之间移动光标(软折行只在光标邻域用缓存镜像测量,长草稿不重测全篇,水平移动完全不测量;步进与钳制都字素安全,含折行行尾完整字素;仅连续垂直移动保持目标列,长草稿滚动保持光标可见),右移一个字素或仅在确有剩余时接受可见建议(对齐桌面 Right Arrow;完全匹配的草稿只移动光标),斜杠插字面 '/';IME 组合期间让路,不新增垂直行。用户文档新增触摸设备一节,双语设计文档记录决策与历史。

## 为什么需要

follow-up suggestion 在干净回合结束后预测下一条 prompt,桌面接受语义是「填入但不发送」,因此建议的斜杠命令绝不会自动执行。触摸用户此前没有对等能力:只能盲发预测或手动重打,违背了展示建议的初衷。移动输入框曾带模拟 Tab/Esc/方向键,因 Tab 在 textarea 后端上是死键而被移除;后来又移除 ↑/↓ 历史步进,因为历史搜索面板是更好的触摸召回路径。如今建议让接受在触摸端第一次有了真实功能,chip 在不复活死键、不命名硬件的前提下提供同样的「填入不发送」手势:它仅在有建议时渲染,「无建议时不出现模拟键盘键」的旧验收仍然成立。早先版本曾配编辑行键(先标 Tab、后标动作词 Fill in);评审表明脱离内容的动词标签仍有理解成本,终版只保留以内容为标签的 chip。历史步进刻意不复活,因为 plain textarea 恢复无法重建 inline tag chips。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

在触摸设备打开 Web Shell,或模拟触摸(Playwright Pixel 7 / iPhone profile、DevTools 设备模式;桌面可用 `?composer=textarea` 强制该后端)。让一个回合干净结束使 daemon 推送建议,或像新增 E2E spec 那样驱动 mock daemon。空输入时确认建议以输入行上方的可点按建议条出现、输入框保持普通占位符;两个变体的编辑行都不带 follow-up 键。点按 chip:文本进入输入框、键盘弹起、不提交、两个触点消失;编辑后自行发送。改点建议条的忽略按钮:建议条消失、发送键禁用。空输入直接点发送:整条建议作为消息提交。输入建议的前缀再点发送:补全后的整条建议提交。输入其它内容:建议条隐藏,发送提交所输文本。多行草稿下点上/下/右确认光标在屏幕显示的行之间移动(短行保持列、文档边缘钳制、长草稿滚入视野);输入 150 个连续字符确认上/下与原生方向键落在同一光标;emoji 草稿确认右移跨过整个 emoji、上移到折行行尾保持完整、斜杠不拆字;下键落到空行并继续;连按上键越过折行边界与原生一致;先右再下确认列跟随新光标;输入并点右键十次确认无隐藏测量节点累积;50k 草稿确认按键即时响应;有可见建议时点右确认填入不提交,草稿已等于建议时只移动光标;点斜杠确认落入字面 '/';空草稿打开展开编辑器确认建议在其 placeholder 上;未聚焦时点忽略确认键盘控件不出现。自动化覆盖:`cd packages/web-shell && PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=<空闲端口> npx playwright test --project=mobile-chromium web-shell.followup.mobile.spec.ts`(27 条用例覆盖以上全部,另含空行与折行锚点、镜像生命周期、18px 图标几何、50k 按键耗时、CDP IME 组合与 zh-CN UI;25 条带 @smoke,PR 门控 smoke 车道双引擎运行),以及 `npx vitest run client/utils/touchCaret.test.ts client/App.css.test.ts client/hooks/useComposerCore.test.ts client/hooks/useComposerCore.mobile.dom.test.tsx client/components/ChatEditor.test.tsx client/i18n.test.ts`(单测钉住有草稿/无可见建议/桌面后端/disabled/simple 变体下的可见性、accept/dismiss 与编辑键接线、composition 与选区重置接线、右键动态标签、完全匹配接受门、列保持与用户跳选区重置及水平后重算、滚动揭示、字素/视觉行光标计算含选区 head 与折行行尾边缘;accept 绝不提交)。

### 证据(改前与改后)

改前:触摸后端上建议仅以 placeholder 文本存在,DOM 中没有建议条、填入键或忽略控件(main 上的结构性缺失,经阅读触摸分支与改动前 E2E 基线确认,当时唯一接受方式是空输入点发送)。改后截图取 Pixel 7 触摸模拟、mock daemon 推送 `run the tests`:

simple 变体——输入行上方带忽略按钮的 chip 建议条,输入框保持普通占位符(单 surface),发送键可用:

![simple 变体建议条](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/mobile-followup-acceptance/followup-bar-simple-v4.png)

default 变体——输入行上方 chip 建议条与输入框普通占位符,编辑行尾侧仅光标/斜杠键(无 follow-up 专用键);两张 default 变体图统一为未聚焦态,条件渲染的收起键盘键缺席:

![default 变体 chip 建议条与光标键](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/mobile-followup-acceptance/followup-keys-row-v6.png)

简体中文 UI(`zh-CN`,建议「运行测试」)——两变体 chip 建议条带本地化忽略标签;编辑行不带 follow-up 键,输入框均保持普通中文占位符:

![简中 simple 变体建议条](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/mobile-followup-acceptance/followup-bar-simple-zh-v2.png)

![简中 default 变体 chip 建议条与光标键](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/mobile-followup-acceptance/followup-keys-row-zh-v6.png)

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Linux 验证使用 Chromium 触摸模拟(mobile-chromium 项目);本机缺 WebKit 运行库,mobile-webkit 项目与 iOS/Android 真机未跑,因此软键盘弹起时新增 44px 行的高度挤压在真机上仍未测量。

### 环境(可选)

Playwright 托管的 Vite dev server(`npm run dev`,SDK 与 daemon-react-sdk 走源码别名)、Pixel 7 设备模拟、逐页 mock daemon;jsdom 单测在 Node 26 下带 `NODE_OPTIONS=--no-experimental-webstorage`,避免本机原生 localStorage 占位遮蔽 jsdom。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡:建议可见时建议条在输入上方增加一行 44px;软键盘弹起的矮视口下会与附件条竞争空间。空闲布局不变,因为建议条仅在有可见建议且草稿为空时渲染。
- 未验证/范围外:iOS/WebKit 真机键盘行为、iPad 外接键盘 Tab/→ 接受(后置 follow-up)、软键盘弹起时的布局测量;历史步进按设计保持移除。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明:无。无公共 API 或 daemon 契约变化;英文、简体中文、繁体中文、俄文目录各新增六个 i18n 键。

设计文档:[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-mobile-followup-acceptance/docs/design/web-shell/web-shell-mobile-followup-acceptance.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-mobile-followup-acceptance/docs/design/web-shell/web-shell-mobile-followup-acceptance.zh-CN.md)

无跟踪 issue;该功能是在评审触摸输入框 follow-up 缺口时直接提出的。

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): wire external foreground Shell into Broker and Control Plane [17357 B/2]
prs.body:
Split from #17357 at source commit `510dc8a1d994331868f71ebb175bf4ebcb8e7219`; candidate B: `5f746c523b309`. This is **[17357 B/2]** — the Runtime Broker dispatch/cancel/reconcile/close fences and Control Plane profile negotiation for the external foreground-Shell lane, stacked on #17472 (**[16023 B/2]**) (`split/16023-resident-workspace`) and #17473 (**[17357 A/2]**) (`split/17357-worker-and-producer`).

## What this PR does

Wires the external foreground-Shell profile (`hosted-workspace-external-shell/1`) through the Control Plane, External Workspace Provisioner, and Runtime Broker:
- **Broker move-before-settle fences**: extracts `RuntimeExecutionExternalShell`, `RuntimeDispatchPayloadAdmission`, and `RuntimeToolAcknowledgements` from `RuntimeBrokerService` and `RuntimeExecutionDispatcher` (lowering `RuntimeBrokerService` from 2028 to 2006). Before dispatching a foreground Shell on an external worker, the Broker opens the worker's capture channel; after the worker finishes, the Broker moves the captured bytes into the control plane's publication via `ExternalShellPublication` and rebuilds the result envelope before settling the execution row.
- **Cancel, reconcile, and close drain proofs**: prevents a worker's raw settled status from settling an un-moved external Shell record on the cancel or reconcile paths, while allowing a proven `not_started` receipt or an already-finished publication to settle cleanly. Session close and Workspace drain require the worker's drained-stop proof and refuse to release storage while an external Shell execution is unsettled.
- **Control Plane & Provisioner negotiation**: gates `hosted-workspace-external-shell/1` behind `qwen.managed-agent.harness.external-workspace-shell-enabled` (default `false`), requires durable tool publication and `default` or `auto-edit` approval mode, pins handle version 2 on `ExternalWorkspaceProvisioner`, and verifies worker publication readiness during placement establishment/reconcile without adding an extra HTTP exchange to every live dispatch confirm.

## Why it's needed

Even with the worker capture routes and producer store from #17473 (**[17357 A/2]**), the Broker and Control Plane must guarantee that a worker's local completion never settles the execution record or releases storage before the captured bytes have been durably published in the control plane. Splitting these 53 Broker/Control-Plane files (+2,782/−468) from the 31 worker/producer files in A/2 isolates the state-machine and lifecycle fences for focused review.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the Broker dispatch lane, drain proof, close recovery, and profile unit tests from `packages/managed-agent-server` on JDK 21:

```bash
cd packages/managed-agent-server
mvn -o -pl verification -am test \
  -Dtest=ExternalShellDispatchLaneTest,ExternalShellDrainProofTest,ExternalShellCloseRecoveryTest,WorkspaceToolProfilesTest,ClassSizeRatchetTest
```

And against disposable MySQL 8.4:

```bash
cd packages/managed-agent-server
mvn -o -Pmysql-integration -pl verification -am verify \
  -Dit.test=ExternalShellCloseRecoveryMySqlIT \
  -Dmysql.url="jdbc:mysql://127.0.0.1:3306/managed_agent_test?allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true&useSSL=false" \
  -Dmysql.user=root -Dmysql.password=<password>
```

Expected:
- `ExternalShellDispatchLaneTest` (9 tests), `ExternalShellDrainProofTest` (6 tests), `ExternalShellCloseRecoveryTest` (6 tests on H2), and `ExternalShellCloseRecoveryMySqlIT` (6 tests on MySQL 8.4) all pass.
- Requesting `toolProfile` without a bound Workspace returns `400 invalid_tool_profile`, and replaying a recorded Session creation succeeds before the live 409 capability check.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for UI — backend Broker and Control Plane wiring with generated OpenAPI client types.

```text
ExternalShellDispatchLaneTest        Tests run: 9, Failures: 0, Errors: 0
ExternalShellDrainProofTest          Tests run: 6, Failures: 0, Errors: 0
ExternalShellCloseRecoveryTest       Tests run: 6, Failures: 0, Errors: 0   (H2)
ExternalShellCloseRecoveryMySqlIT    Tests run: 6, Failures: 0, Errors: 0   (MySQL 8.4.11)
WorkspaceToolProfilesTest            Tests run: 3, Failures: 0, Errors: 0
mvn -o test-compile                  BUILD SUCCESS (all 15 reactor modules)
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local JDK 21 (`openjdk@21`) and disposable MySQL 8.4.11 on macOS.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the Broker sits on the byte-moving critical path before settling any external foreground Shell execution, so an unreachable or unacknowledged worker capture keeps the execution recoverable (`UNKNOWN`) and blocks Session close rather than losing output.
- Not validated / out of scope: worker capture routes and `ExternalShellPublicationProducer` implementation details are covered in #17473 (**[17357 A/2]**). Background Shell and `monitor` remain out of scope for external workers.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none for existing placements. `qwen.managed-agent.harness.external-workspace-shell-enabled` defaults to `false`.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/17357-broker-and-control-plane/docs/design/2026-10-25-external-hosted-workspace.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/17357-broker-and-control-plane/docs/design/2026-10-25-external-hosted-workspace.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Part of #15512 (phase 2, slice C). Split from #17357 (`[17357 B/2]`).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

自 #17357 的源码提交 `510dc8a1d994331868f71ebb175bf4ebcb8e7219` 拆分而来；候选提交 B 为 `5f746c523b309`。本 PR 是 **[17357 B/2]** —— 包含外部前台 Shell 通道在 Runtime Broker 的派发/取消/对账/关闭围栏以及控制面 profile 协商，堆叠在 #17472 (**[16023 B/2]**)（`split/16023-resident-workspace`）与 #17473 (**[17357 A/2]**)（`split/17357-worker-and-producer`）之上。

## 这个 PR 做了什么

将外部前台 Shell profile（`hosted-workspace-external-shell/1`）贯通至控制面、External Workspace Provisioner 与 Runtime Broker：
- **Broker「先搬运后结算」围栏**：从 `RuntimeBrokerService` 与 `RuntimeExecutionDispatcher` 中抽离 `RuntimeExecutionExternalShell`、`RuntimeDispatchPayloadAdmission` 和 `RuntimeToolAcknowledgements`（将 `RuntimeBrokerService` 从 2028 行降至 2006 行）。在向外部 worker 派发前台 Shell 前，Broker 先打开 worker 的 capture 通道；待 worker 执行结束后，Broker 通过 `ExternalShellPublication` 将捕获字节搬入控制面 publication 并重建结果信封，随后才结算执行记录。
- **取消、对账与关闭排空证明**：防止取消或对账路径仅凭 worker 返回的 settled 状态直接结算尚未完成搬运的外部 Shell 记录，同时允许已证实的 `not_started` 回执或已完成搬运的 publication 正常结算。Session 关闭与 Workspace 排空要求校验 worker 的 drained-stop 证明，在外部 Shell 执行未结算前拒绝释放存储。
- **控制面与 Provisioner 协商**：将 `hosted-workspace-external-shell/1` 置于独立开关 `qwen.managed-agent.harness.external-workspace-shell-enabled`（默认 `false`）之后，强制要求启用持久化 tool publication 以及 `default` 或 `auto-edit` 审批模式；在 `ExternalWorkspaceProvisioner` 上使用独立的 handle 版本 2，并在建立或对账 placement 时校验 worker 的 publication 就绪状态（日常存活确认不增加额外 HTTP 往返）。

## 为什么需要它

在 #17473 (**[17357 A/2]**) 提供了 worker 捕获路由与 producer 存储的基础上，Broker 与控制面还必须确保：绝不能在捕获字节持久化到控制面之前仅凭 worker 的本地完成状态就结算记录或释放存储。将这 53 个 Broker/控制面文件（+2,782/−468）从 A/2 的 31 个 worker/producer 文件中拆出，便于集中评审状态机与生命周期围栏。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

在 JDK 21 下从 `packages/managed-agent-server` 运行 Broker 派发通道、排空证明、关闭恢复与 profile 单元测试：

```bash
cd packages/managed-agent-server
mvn -o -pl verification -am test \
  -Dtest=ExternalShellDispatchLaneTest,ExternalShellDrainProofTest,ExternalShellCloseRecoveryTest,WorkspaceToolProfilesTest,ClassSizeRatchetTest
```

以及基于 MySQL 8.4 的集成验证：

```bash
cd packages/managed-agent-server
mvn -o -Pmysql-integration -pl verification -am verify \
  -Dit.test=ExternalShellCloseRecoveryMySqlIT \
  -Dmysql.url="jdbc:mysql://127.0.0.1:3306/managed_agent_test?allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true&useSSL=false" \
  -Dmysql.user=root -Dmysql.password=<password>
```

预期行为：
- `ExternalShellDispatchLaneTest`（9 个用例）、`ExternalShellDrainProofTest`（6 个用例）、`ExternalShellCloseRecoveryTest`（H2 6 个用例）与 `ExternalShellCloseRecoveryMySqlIT`（MySQL 8.4 6 个用例）全部通过。
- 未绑定 Workspace 时请求 `toolProfile` 返回 `400 invalid_tool_profile`，且已记录的 Session 创建幂等重放在实时 409 能力检查前直接返回。

### 证据（修改前 / 修改后）

N/A（无 UI 变更 —— 纯后端 Broker 与控制面编排及自动生成的 OpenAPI 类型）。

```text
ExternalShellDispatchLaneTest        Tests run: 9, Failures: 0, Errors: 0
ExternalShellDrainProofTest          Tests run: 6, Failures: 0, Errors: 0
ExternalShellCloseRecoveryTest       Tests run: 6, Failures: 0, Errors: 0   (H2)
ExternalShellCloseRecoveryMySqlIT    Tests run: 6, Failures: 0, Errors: 0   (MySQL 8.4.11)
WorkspaceToolProfilesTest            Tests run: 3, Failures: 0, Errors: 0
mvn -o test-compile                  BUILD SUCCESS (全部 15 个模块通过)
```

### 测试平台

|   操作系统   | 状态 |
| :----------: | :--: |
|   🍏 macOS   |  ✅  |
|  🪟 Windows  |  ⚠️  |
|   🐧 Linux   |  ⚠️  |

### 环境说明（可选）

macOS 本地 JDK 21（`openjdk@21`）与临时 MySQL 8.4.11。

## 风险与影响范围

- 主要风险或取舍：Broker 位于每次外部前台 Shell 结算前的字节搬运关键路径上；若 worker 捕获通道不可达或未完成确认，记录将保持可恢复的 `UNKNOWN` 状态并阻止关闭 Session，而不会丢失输出。
- 未验证 / 范围外：worker 捕获路由与 `ExternalShellPublicationProducer` 的实现细节由 #17473 (**[17357 A/2]**) 覆盖；后台 Shell 与 `monitor` 仍不在外部 worker 支持范围内。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：对存量 placement 无影响。`qwen.managed-agent.harness.external-workspace-shell-enabled` 默认为 `false`。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/17357-broker-and-control-plane/docs/design/2026-10-25-external-hosted-workspace.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/17357-broker-and-control-plane/docs/design/2026-10-25-external-hosted-workspace.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

属于 #15512（phase 2, slice C）。拆自 #17357（`[17357 B/2]`）。

</details>

Stack: **[#15657](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15657) → [#15658](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15658) → [#15659](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15659)**. This is **B**, based on A (`split/13902-agent-identity`, `3294001f39040a668fcbad20045b64e03dc1b6e6`); base branch: `split/13902-agent-identity`. C (`split/13902-teammate-activity`) depends on B. Split from #13902 at source commit `6ed7884c381dfe1c59bd975d6cf61dbb41ef441c`; candidate B: `435e4f949eca7232c2b48d3a259f5083cb788b8a`. Review B against A to isolate the coordination change.

## What this PR does

Connects an ACP-hosted leader to Team reports, roster membership and teammate approvals. Reports and join/exit notices enter the existing peer notification path with canonical teammate identity, survive recording and replay, and receive teammate attribution in the Web Shell. Pending reports participate in work holds, reversible close, queue overflow and shutdown flushing.

Teammate approvals reach the host independently of the leader's permission queue. Session scope, request UUIDs, binding epochs, ownership checks and retirement on manager replacement or teammate exit keep approval lifetime tied to the owning session. B includes producer, persistence, bridge, SDK/UI consumers and their tests. It consumes A's shared identity contract without depending on subagent runtime behavior. Tool activity and inter-agent message display arrive in C.

## Why it's needed

Without a leader sink, ACP-hosted teammate reports remain unread and teammate approval events have no consumer. The leader and its client need a delivery path that carries attribution, preserves undrained reports and exposes teammate approval requests.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. At candidate `435e4f949eca7232c2b48d3a259f5083cb788b8a`, run `npm run build` from the repository root, then run the package-local commands below serially. Each Vitest command runs from the stated package directory.
2. Deliver a teammate report and roster join/exit, then reload the transcript. Confirm canonical attribution, peer semantics and turn-marker correlation. Exercise reversible close, pending-report holds, overflow, repeat flush and shutdown with undrained reports.
3. Leave a teammate approval unanswered while the leader requests its own tool approval. Confirm the leader request remains visible. Exercise host answer/failure, standalone policy, session ownership, manager rebinding, teammate exit and cancellation; evaluate the inherited feedback below separately.

```sh
# cwd: packages/acp-bridge
../../node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/bridge-workflow-ancestor-trust.test.ts src/bridgeClient.test.ts src/transcript-replay.test.ts
# cwd: packages/cli
../../node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/acp-integration/acpAgent.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/team-sink.test.ts
# cwd: packages/core
../../node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/agents/team/test-utils/coordination-harness.test.ts src/services/api-user-prompt.test.ts
# cwd: packages/sdk-typescript
../../node_modules/.bin/vitest run test/agent-identity.test.ts
# cwd: packages/web-shell
../../node_modules/.bin/vitest run client/adapters/transcriptToMessages.test.ts client/components/messages/SystemMessage.test.tsx
```

### Evidence (Before & After)

On candidate `435e4f949eca7232c2b48d3a259f5083cb788b8a`, `npm run build` exited 0. The focused package-local Vitest runs passed **3058 tests in 11 test files**: ACP bridge 356, CLI 2246, core 130, SDK 13 and Web Shell 313. These counts come from this split candidate, not the original PR.

Runtime, UI E2E and standalone typecheck were not run. Matched before/after protocol, persistence and UI evidence is not available. The build and focused tests do not establish that all verification obligations are complete; this PR remains a draft and the unresolved feedback below remains open.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Build and focused tests; runtime/UI E2E and standalone typecheck not run |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Local isolated worktree; repository-root build followed by serial package-local Vitest runs.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: notification durability and session-scoped approval lifetime cross queue, recording, bridge and shutdown boundaries. Roster transitions are event-based; there is no current-state snapshot for late attach or reconnect.
- Not validated / out of scope: exact-SHA runtime/UI and cross-platform validation are pending. Observational activity belongs to C. The source's unresolved feedback is retained.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: optional identity/attribution fields and session-scoped teammate permission metadata are added; no transcript migration is introduced.

Inherited unresolved feedback is not fixed by splitting:

- [R8-3: blanket XML escaping changes report/notice envelope fidelity across hosts](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#discussion_r4372372660).
- [R9-2: team teardown can queue a leader wake for each roster exit](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#discussion_r4372372667).
- [R9-5: the inserted permission interface changes BridgeClient JSDoc attachment](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#discussion_r4372372676).
- [R9-7: the abort fake does not reproduce reject-on-abort behavior](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#discussion_r4372372682).
- [R9-8: detach coverage does not establish that exit handling stays silent](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#discussion_r4372372686).
- [R9-9: an unoffered permission option can be reported as host failure](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#discussion_r4372372690).

A's unresolved replay feedback is inherited through the stack; its ownership remains with A.

Design: [English](docs/design/2026-10-11-agent-team-identity-projection.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-10-11-agent-team-identity-projection.zh-CN.md). Both documents expand A with coordination decisions, constraints, acceptance criteria and the C follow-up boundary.

## Linked Issues

Related: #13785. Split source: #13902. This PR remains a draft. No automatic issue or PR closure is requested.

Stack links:

- A: [#15657](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15657) — prerequisite.
- B: [#15658](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15658) — this PR.
- C: [#15659](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15659) — depends on B.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

堆叠顺序：**[#15657](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15657) → [#15658](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15658) → [#15659](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15659)**。本 PR 是 **B**，基于 A（`split/13902-agent-identity`，`3294001f39040a668fcbad20045b64e03dc1b6e6`）；以 `split/13902-agent-identity` 为 base。C（`split/13902-teammate-activity`）依赖 B。拆分来源 #13902，固定源提交 `6ed7884c381dfe1c59bd975d6cf61dbb41ef441c`；B 候选为 `435e4f949eca7232c2b48d3a259f5083cb788b8a`。请相对 A 评审 B，以隔离协调层改动。

### 本 PR 做什么

将 ACP-hosted leader 接入 Team 报告、成员变更和队友审批。报告及加入/退出通知携带规范队友身份，进入现有 peer 通知路径，通过录制和重放保留，并在 Web Shell 中标注队友。待处理报告参与 work hold、可逆关闭、队列溢出和关机 flush。

队友审批独立于 leader 权限队列到达 host。会话范围、请求 UUID、binding epoch、所有权检查及 manager 替换或队友退出时的撤回，将审批生命周期绑定到所属会话。B 包含生产者、持久化、bridge、SDK/UI 消费方及配套测试。它消费 A 的共享身份契约，不依赖 subagent 运行时行为。工具活动与 agent 间消息展示由 C 交付。

### 为什么需要

缺少 leader sink 时，ACP-hosted 队友报告保持未读，队友审批事件没有消费方。leader 和客户端需要能传递归因、保存未排空报告并展示队友审批请求的投递路径。

### 评审测试计划

1. 在候选 `435e4f949eca7232c2b48d3a259f5083cb788b8a` 上从仓库根目录运行 `npm run build`，再串行执行英文部分列出的各包命令。每条 Vitest 命令均从标明的包目录执行。
2. 投递队友报告及成员加入/退出，再重载 transcript。确认规范归因、peer 语义和轮次标记关联。覆盖可逆关闭、待处理报告 hold、溢出、重复 flush 及含未排空报告的关机。
3. 保持队友审批未答复，同时让 leader 请求自己的工具审批，确认 leader 请求仍可见。覆盖 host 答复/失败、standalone 策略、会话所有权、manager 重绑定、队友退出及取消；下述继承反馈需另行验证。

**前后证据：**候选 `435e4f949eca7232c2b48d3a259f5083cb788b8a` 的 `npm run build` 退出码为 0。各包目录内的聚焦 Vitest 共通过 **11 个测试文件、3058 项测试**：ACP bridge 356、CLI 2246、core 130、SDK 13、Web Shell 313。这些数字来自本次拆分候选，不是原 PR 的历史结果。

未运行 runtime、UI E2E 或独立 typecheck，也没有匹配的协议、持久化和 UI 前后证据。构建与聚焦测试不代表所有验证义务均已完成；本 PR 保持 draft，下述未解决反馈仍然开放。

**测试平台：**macOS 已执行构建及聚焦测试，未运行 runtime/UI E2E 或独立 typecheck；Windows、Linux 未测试。

**环境：**本地隔离 worktree；从仓库根目录构建，再串行运行各包目录内的 Vitest。

### 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：通知持久性及会话级审批生命周期横跨队列、录制、bridge 和关机边界。成员变更基于事件，晚挂接或重连没有当前状态快照。
- 未验证或范围外：精确 SHA 的运行时/UI 及跨平台验证待完成。观察性活动属于 C。源提交的未解决反馈继续保留。
- 兼容性与迁移：新增可选身份/归因字段及会话级队友审批元数据；没有引入 transcript 迁移。

以下继承的未解决反馈未因拆分而修复：

- [R8-3：完整 XML 转义改变报告/通知 envelope 保真性及跨 host 行为](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#discussion_r4372372660)。
- [R9-2：Team teardown 可能为每个成员退出排入一次 leader 唤醒](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#discussion_r4372372667)。
- [R9-5：插入 permission interface 改变 BridgeClient JSDoc 附着](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#discussion_r4372372676)。
- [R9-7：abort fake 未模拟 reject-on-abort 行为](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#discussion_r4372372682)。
- [R9-8：detach 测试未证实退出处理保持静默](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#discussion_r4372372686)。
- [R9-9：未提供的 permission option 可能被报告为 host 失败](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#discussion_r4372372690)。

A 的未解决 replay 反馈也通过堆叠继承，责任归属仍在 A。

设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-10-11-agent-team-identity-projection.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-10-11-agent-team-identity-projection.zh-CN.md)。两份文档在 A 基础上扩展协调层决策、约束、验收标准及 C 的后续边界。

**关联：**#13785；拆分来源 #13902。本 PR 保持 draft，不请求自动关闭任何 issue 或 PR。

堆叠链接：

- A：[#15657](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15657)，前置依赖。
- B：[#15658](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15658)，本 PR。
- C：[#15659](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15659)，依赖 B。

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): preserve Markdown in height-bounded tool results
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Restores Markdown formatting in completed CLI tool results while retaining terminal-height limits, truncation cues, and expansion. Height accounting follows word wrapping, list markers, code gutters/tabs, and the actual table layout. Capped shell output, explicit plain text, and raw-file details keep their existing behavior.

Session records preserve the executed tool's display declaration so resumed results retain their rendering mode. Table-closing text is measured as it renders, tables continued across code blocks use the bounded literal preview, and large table inputs avoid argument-limit failures and invisible empty-table layout.

## Why it's needed

A terminal-height budget currently disables Markdown even for short results, so selecting an answer produces literal `**Color**: Blue` instead of a bold label.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Ask: `Use ask_user_question exactly once to ask me which color I prefer, with options Blue and Green. Do not use other tools or edit any files. After my answer, say Done.` Select Blue and submit. The completed answer summary should show a bold Color label without literal asterisks.
2. Check long Markdown results at narrow widths: content should remain bounded, disclose hidden content, and reveal the tail when expanded. Shell caps and explicitly plain-text results should remain unchanged.
3. Resume a session containing explicitly plain tool output with headings, list markers, or table-looking lines. It should remain literal; a result recorded as Markdown should retain its formatting even if the current tool declaration differs.
4. Check a task-list line directly after a table, table rows resumed after a fenced code block, and large MCP progress tables. The view should remain usable and bounded, with the tail retained or hidden content disclosed. A table with no data rows remains hidden while following text stays visible.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Actual PTY frames, trimmed to the completed result:

Before (global CLI 0.25.1):
```text
✓ AskUserQuestion Ask user 1 question
  User has provided the following answers:

  **Color**: Blue
```

After (local bundled CLI):
```text
✓ AskUserQuestion Ask user 1 question
  User has provided the following answers:

  Color: Blue
```

The terminal-buffer check confirms all five Color cells are bold in four captured frames. These are earlier interactive baseline captures; that live flow was not rerun for the review follow-up.

Current local validation: 780 tests passed across seven related renderer/stream suites; build, bundle, typecheck, changed-file lint/format, and diff checks passed. Six new component regressions have pre-fix failing evidence. Two independent agents each reviewed the complete combined PR/workspace diff; their final positive probes passed 14/14 and 18/18, including real Ink frames, actual agent-history adapters, and baseline component controls.

An AppContainer initialization-count test failed intermittently and also failed with merge-base source; its current full-file rerun passed 214/214. This baseline instability remains disclosed and is not counted as an initially clean run.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ |

### Environment (optional)

100×24 Python PTY, local bundled CLI, configured DeepSeek model; terminal frames reconstructed with xterm/headless.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: shared height accounting also affects streaming assistant output; exact table layout costs more than approximate estimation. An oversized source line or later table may be omitted entirely, with a visible truncation cue. Tool results use a literal tail preview when full Markdown cannot be bounded reliably. The renderer, shared estimator, recording/replay metadata, and their regression tests land together because live and resumed output must agree on both display mode and height; splitting these fixes would leave one of those paths inconsistent.
- Not validated / out of scope: Markdown inside selector questions/options, long-result Ctrl+S keyboard E2E, terminal resize, other renderer backends, Windows/Linux, the full repository test suite, and the CLI no-sandbox integration suite. Long-result expansion is covered by Ink state changes, not keyboard E2E. The new progress/table cases use real components and adapter-shaped data, not a live MCP service or model session. Local results do not establish remote CI success.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no migration required. Core session-record metadata gains an optional display-mode flag; legacy records use the registered declaration, or plain text when unavailable. Dependencies, configuration, and model-facing messages are unchanged.

Design: [English](https://github.com/shenyankm/qwen-code/blob/worktree-toolresult-markdown-height/docs/design/toolresult-markdown-height.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/shenyankm/qwen-code/blob/worktree-toolresult-markdown-height/docs/design/toolresult-markdown-height.zh-CN.md). Both versions contain matching decisions, constraints, and acceptance criteria.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13956

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

恢复 CLI 已完成工具结果的 Markdown 格式，同时保留终端高度限制、截断提示和展开能力。高度计算计入按词换行、列表标记、代码行号/Tab 和实际表格布局。受限 Shell 输出、明确的纯文本与原始文件详情保持现有行为。

会话记录保留实际执行工具的显示声明，使恢复后的结果保持原有渲染模式。表格结束后的文本按真实渲染方式计量；跨代码块续接的表格使用受高度限制的原文预览；超大表格避免函数参数数量上限异常，并跳过不可见的空表格布局。

## 为什么需要

当前只要存在终端高度预算，就会禁用 Markdown，即使结果很短；因此选择后的摘要显示字面量 `**Color**: Blue`，而不是粗体标签。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 输入：`Use ask_user_question exactly once to ask me which color I prefer, with options Blue and Green. Do not use other tools or edit any files. After my answer, say Done.` 选择 Blue 并提交。完成后的回答摘要应显示粗体 Color 标签，没有字面星号。
2. 在窄宽度下检查较长 Markdown 结果：内容应受高度限制、告知存在隐藏内容，并在展开后显示尾部。Shell 行数上限和明确的纯文本结果应保持不变。
3. 恢复包含明确纯文本工具输出的会话，内容可含标题、列表标记或类似表格的文本。这些内容应保持原文；记录为 Markdown 的结果应保持格式，即使当前工具声明已改变。
4. 检查紧接表格的任务列表行、跨代码块续接的表格行和超大 MCP 进度表格。视图应保持可用且受高度限制，保留尾部或明确提示隐藏内容。没有数据行的表格仍然隐藏，后续文本保持可见。

### 证据（修复前后）

实际 PTY 帧，裁取已完成的结果部分：

修复前（全局 CLI 0.25.1）：
```text
✓ AskUserQuestion Ask user 1 question
  User has provided the following answers:

  **Color**: Blue
```

修复后（本地打包 CLI）：
```text
✓ AskUserQuestion Ask user 1 question
  User has provided the following answers:

  Color: Blue
```

终端缓冲区检查确认，四个捕获帧中 Color 的五个单元格均为粗体。这些是较早的交互基线记录；本次 review 跟进未重新运行该实时交互流程。

当前本地验证：7 个相关渲染/流式测试文件共 780 项通过；build、bundle、typecheck、修改文件的 lint/格式检查及 diff 检查通过。6 个新增组件回归均保留修复前失败证据。两名独立子代理各自审阅完整 PR 与工作区合并 diff；最终正向探针分别为 14/14 和 18/18 通过，包含真实 Ink 帧、实际代理历史适配链及基线组件对照。

AppContainer 的一个初始化次数测试曾偶发失败，使用 merge-base 源码也复现失败；当前版本全文件重跑为 214/214 通过。此基线不稳定性继续披露，未将首次运行计为全绿。

### 测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :--: | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ |

### 环境（可选）

100×24 Python PTY、本地打包 CLI、已配置的 DeepSeek 模型；使用 xterm/headless 重建终端帧。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：共享高度计算也影响流式助手输出；精确表格布局比近似估计开销更大。超长源文本行或位于其他内容后的表格可能被整块省略，但会显示截断提示。无法可靠限制完整 Markdown 高度时，工具结果使用保留尾部的原文预览。渲染器、共享估高、记录/恢复元数据及其回归测试需要一起落地，因为实时与恢复输出的显示模式和高度必须一致；拆开这些修复会留下不一致的路径。
- 未验证 / 范围之外：选择器题目/选项内部的 Markdown、长结果 Ctrl+S 键盘 E2E、终端缩放、其他渲染后端、Windows/Linux、全仓测试及 CLI 无沙箱集成测试套件。长结果展开由 Ink 状态切换覆盖，不是键盘 E2E。新增进度/表格场景使用真实组件和适配链形态的数据，并未连接真实 MCP 服务或模型会话。本地结果不能证明远程 CI 通过。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无需迁移。Core 会话记录元数据新增可选显示模式标志；旧记录使用已注册工具声明，无法获取时使用纯文本。依赖、配置和面向模型的消息保持不变。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/shenyankm/qwen-code/blob/worktree-toolresult-markdown-height/docs/design/toolresult-markdown-height.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/shenyankm/qwen-code/blob/worktree-toolresult-markdown-height/docs/design/toolresult-markdown-height.zh-CN.md)。两版的设计决策、约束与验收标准完整对应。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #13956

</details>

prs.title: feat(cli): polish terminal layout and streaming interactions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Keeps the composer at the bottom, centers bounded dialogs over the transcript, and places approval mode beside its cycling shortcut on the input's lower-right border in main and agent views. Virtual scrolling uses smaller paced updates; transcript, preview, and input share consistent drag selection and copying.

Shows completed safe tool/thought activity as muted summaries. Expanding reveals compact command/path rows and retains a clickable collapse header; Ctrl+O reaches original full details. Closing a process clears its expanded children, and independently virtualized members retain their own viewport visibility.

Uses fixed deadlines for streamed state updates and terminal drawing, reuses stable Markdown prefixes and unchanged code-line highlights, and keeps original stream-boundary ordering. Actual controls-height measurement and consistent virtual-message budgets keep advancing text and the final transcript line visible when the footer or auxiliary panels change height.

## Why it's needed

Short conversations left the input above unused space; large settings/session dialogs could overflow. Repeated process details competed with answers, and opening a tool summary could not be reversed. Selection could include popup borders or trigger expansion on release, while approval mode and its shortcut appeared in different places.

Regular small text chunks still appeared in uneven groups. A full new buffering window after each batch introduced avoidable waiting, and stable Markdown/code was processed repeatedly. Long pending paragraphs could hide their advancing tail in short virtual viewports. A stale controls-height budget could also clip the final checkpoint name from `/restore` until scrolling corrected it.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start an empty session and open `/settings`, `/resume`, model, theme and permission dialogs. The composer should stay at the bottom; dialogs should remain centered and bounded, with the draft restored afterward. Check main and agent inputs: mode and cycling shortcut should share the lower-right border, without a duplicate footer hint. Resize narrow and restore.
2. Run reads, commands and thinking. Completed safe activity should use a muted summary, while live work, failures and approvals remain visible. Click to open compact details, click the retained header to close, and use Ctrl+O for original output. Repeat during and after generation; opening a child then closing its parent should leave the process closed.
3. Scroll slowly, rapidly and in reverse; use PageUp/Home/End and drag the scrollbar. One upward row should remain detached as content arrives. Drag ASCII, Chinese and multiline text in transcript, preview and main/agent input: copied text should match the highlight and exclude borders. Releasing a selection on a summary should not toggle it; an ordinary click should.
4. Stream prose, Chinese, open code and Markdown/list/table content. Updates should advance with less repeated work and retain the exact final suffix. Resize and change rendering context; completed prefixes, syntax colors, gutters and copy hints should remain correct. A long paragraph should keep advancing before completion in a short virtual viewport.
5. Cancel during buffered output and stream reasoning-to-answer, tool-to-answer and inline-image transitions. Preserve the received tail and ordering. Native scrollback and screen-reader modes should retain their existing layout and completion behavior. Do not infer a physical terminal frame rate from a timer setting.
6. Open and close completion, shortcuts and auxiliary panels after history overflows. The final transcript line should remain visible. List checkpoints with `/restore`, then hot-restore and cold-resume one; the name, files and retained conversation should agree without a scroll workaround.

### Evidence (Before & After)

| Installed CLI layout | Bottom-composer layout |
| --- | --- |
| ![Installed CLI](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/b254b90397b50e768275c772449a21a27a936925/docs/design/images/tui-workspace/before-installed.png?raw=true) | ![Bottom composer](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/b254b90397b50e768275c772449a21a27a936925/docs/design/images/tui-workspace/after-startup.png?raw=true) |

These earlier layout captures use isolated fake providers and synthetic data. The installed CLI reports a 0.25.0 banner and is an environment comparison, not a rebuilt PR base. Separate E2E reports record the later pointer, expansion and approval-shortcut checks with their exact artifacts.

With identical synthetic payloads in real PTYs, Chinese visible-marker gap P95 changes from 67ms to 51ms; ASCII remains 51ms. Server-marker-to-visible lag P95 changes from 59/65/93ms to 52/50/88ms for ASCII/Chinese/mixed Markdown. Mixed Markdown visible-gap P95 rises from 117ms to 134ms, so this is not a uniform improvement across all intervals. All five final payloads, including bursts and an 80-line open code block, match exactly.

In a separate controlled 72-update renderer profile, body-write gap P95 changes from 34.73/37.61/38.58ms to 19.77/20.40/19.97ms for prose/labeled code/unlabeled code. Repeated highlighting of unchanged code lines drops from 1296 calls to zero. This profile excludes the application event buffer and native terminal presentation.

Full build, repository typecheck, bundle, focused unit tests, scoped lint/format checks and clean Ink patch application pass. The separate streaming E2E comment records the baseline, candidate and final measurements, exact-content checks, coverage and exclusions.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Real PTYs, Canary/xterm, main and Arena agent views |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not runtime tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not runtime tested |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 26.13.1; default Ink renderer; loopback fake providers; isolated settings, sessions, workspace and clipboard shim. Automated pointer checks use standard SGR through Canary/xterm. The user confirmed transcript dragging in Warp; this is not a native Warp/Grok frame-rate comparison.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: shared viewport geometry, pointer ownership, cache invalidation and the existing Ink patch affect terminal behavior. Frozen prefixes are conservative; unfinished text/code still requires work, and very large provider bursts can appear in one update.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows/Linux runtime interaction and full OpenTUI parity. Arena retains its committed-round display. No output worker or physical VSync acknowledgement is introduced, and no fixed visible 60/120 FPS is promised.
- Known follow-up: continuing one unfinished answer can shift a detached viewport toward older content. The same 16-row shift reproduces in archived pre-increment source with pinned Ink and a test-only JSX runtime shim; this auxiliary replay establishes behavior, not binary timing. The limitation is retained for a focused viewport fix and is not claimed resolved here.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no configuration migration, provider/protocol change or permission-policy change. Input selection copies text; editable replacement ranges are not added. Native scrollback retains its height safety limits.

Designs: [visual hierarchy — English](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/b254b90397b50e768275c772449a21a27a936925/docs/design/tui-visual-hierarchy.md) / [中文](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/b254b90397b50e768275c772449a21a27a936925/docs/design/tui-visual-hierarchy.zh-CN.md); [workspace layout — English](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/53d4cbd95f513d4511fc666fb96258c6d58384d7/docs/design/tui-workspace-layout.md) / [中文](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/53d4cbd95f513d4511fc666fb96258c6d58384d7/docs/design/tui-workspace-layout.zh-CN.md); [scrolling and selection — English](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/43275f059d96d46a2f926ef1519e56bd83848adc/docs/design/tui-pointer-and-composer.md) / [中文](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/43275f059d96d46a2f926ef1519e56bd83848adc/docs/design/tui-pointer-and-composer.zh-CN.md); [streaming and controls — English](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/507e7dfc5410be0460279d503cb4ce3329e55b72/docs/design/tui-streaming-cadence.md) / [中文](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/507e7dfc5410be0460279d503cb4ce3329e55b72/docs/design/tui-streaming-cadence.zh-CN.md); [incremental streaming — English](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/116632670d512725dbeedfb8ae523c55a1bf88c7/docs/design/tui-incremental-streaming.md) / [中文](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/116632670d512725dbeedfb8ae523c55a1bf88c7/docs/design/tui-incremental-streaming.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

prs.title: fix(core): deliver SubagentStart context to initial prompts
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Delivers `SubagentStart.additionalContext` to the initial user prompt for foreground agents, background agents, forks, and cold background resume. Existing `hook_context` interpolation remains available for system prompts. Shared helpers keep the append behavior consistent, and prompt-bound context is capped at the established 10,000-character limit.

## Why it's needed

SubagentStart hooks could execute successfully and return `additionalContext`, yet the initial subagent only received the original task. The context was stored in `hook_context` but was not appended to `task_prompt` on initial launch paths. As a result, hook-provided instructions never reached the model unless a custom system prompt explicitly interpolated them.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the focused core suites:

```bash
corepack pnpm --filter @qwen-code/qwen-code-core exec vitest run src/tools/agent/agent.test.ts src/agents/background-agent-resume.test.ts
corepack pnpm --filter @qwen-code/qwen-code-core run typecheck
```

Confirm coverage of foreground, background, fork, and cold-resume launches. The tests assert that the original task is preserved and followed by exactly two newlines and the hook context. A key-aware fake distinguishes `task_prompt` from `hook_context`. A separate case verifies the 10,000-character cap.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the new foreground, background, and cold-resume tests failed because `task_prompt` contained only the original task. The over-cap test also failed because the complete hook context was appended.

After: all 524 tests in the two suites pass. TypeScript typecheck, Prettier, and ESLint pass. Mutation checks also behaved as intended: reading the wrong context key turned the three launch tests red, and removing the shared helpers' `task_prompt` write turned all four path tests red.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

WSL2, Node.js 22.22.3, pnpm 10.26.2 via Corepack. Unit tests and static checks only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: initial subagent prompts now include non-empty hook context. Prompt-bound context is capped at 10,000 characters to avoid unbounded context growth.
- Not validated / out of scope: the full root prepare build did not complete locally because the CLI build was killed with status 137. Hook deny/error semantics and external ACP executors are unchanged. macOS and Windows were not tested locally.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The change is additive and requires no migration.

## Linked Issues

N/A — no tracking issue was filed.

## Why it's needed

SubagentStart 钩子此前可以成功执行并返回 `additionalContext`，但初始子代理仍只收到原始任务。上下文虽保存到 `hook_context`，却没有在初始启动路径中追加到 `task_prompt`。因此，除非自定义系统 prompt 显式插值，否则钩子提供的指令无法到达模型。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

### Evidence (Before & After)

修复前：新增的前台、后台和冷恢复测试失败，因为 `task_prompt` 只包含原始任务。超上限测试也失败，因为完整钩子上下文被直接追加。

### Environment (optional)

WSL2、Node.js 22.22.3、通过 Corepack 使用的 pnpm 10.26.2。仅执行单元测试和静态检查。

## Risk & Scope

- 主要风险或取舍：初始子代理 prompt 现在会包含非空的钩子上下文。写入 prompt 的上下文限制为 10,000 字符，以避免上下文无限增长。
- 未验证或不在范围内：本地完整根目录 prepare 构建未完成，因为 CLI 构建以状态 137 被终止。钩子的拒绝和错误语义以及外部 ACP 执行器均未改变。macOS 和 Windows 未在本地测试。

prs.body:
## What this PR does

In AUTO mode, the classifier's transcript no longer lists the tool call it is classifying as a `Prior action`. The scheduler and the ACP session pass the call's id down to the transcript builder, and the builder skips the one `functionCall` in history that carries that id. The call still appears once, as the call to classify.

## Why it's needed

History is read after the model turn that issued the call has been recorded, so the pending call was rendered twice: first as `Prior action: …`, as if it had already run, and then under `## Pending tool call to classify`. The classifier then reasons about a retry instead of a first execution. #16496 has a transcript captured from a real session and the measurements: on 61 cases where the user did not authorize a destructive action, removing the echoed call took wrongly allowed verdicts from 61% to 37% on qwen3.7-max and from 30% to 19% on deepseek-v4-pro, with the consent and polite-request controls unchanged.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- `packages/core/src/permissions/classifier-transcript.test.ts`, `describe('the pending call recorded in history')`: the pending call is rendered only as the call to classify; an earlier call with the same command, which did run, is kept; the other calls issued in the same model turn are kept; nothing is dropped when the id is missing or not in history.
- `classifier.test.ts`: `classifyAction` keeps the pending call out of the prior actions it sends.
- `autoMode.test.ts`: `evaluateAutoMode` hands the call id to the classifier.
- `coreToolScheduler.test.ts`: both scheduler paths (the AUTO classifier path and the pending L4 allow path) pass the id, so the classifier request holds no prior action for the pending call.
- `coreToolScheduler.test.ts`, sub-agent calls: when a call issued inside a sub-agent carries the same id as a finished call in the session history, that finished call stays in the classifier's prior actions. Covered for both scheduler paths, and for both ways a sub-agent frame is marked (agent id, agent chat). With the check disabled, these 3 tests fail.
- `Session.test.ts` (ACP): the session passes `callId` to `evaluateAutoMode`.

Removing only the three-line skip in `buildClassifierContents` makes 5 of these tests fail; restoring it makes them pass.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before, from the session captured in #16496 (`git branch -D tmp/spike` had not run when this request was sent):

```
[5] user: Prior action: run_shell_command({"command":"git branch -D tmp/spike","cwd":"/path/to/repo"})
[6] user: ## Pending tool call to classify
          Tool: run_shell_command
          Arguments: {"command": "git branch -D tmp/spike", "cwd": "/path/to/repo"}
```

After: entry `[5]` is gone and `[6]` is unchanged. This is what the transcript tests assert. I did not re-capture a live session on this branch.

Local runs at `5c2b296ea4` (`main` merged at `b2b522c2ed`):

- core: `coreToolScheduler.test.ts` and all of `permissions/`: 17 files, 2,044 tests passed.
- core: `agents/runtime/agent-core*` and `tools/agent`: 7 files, 689 tests passed.
- ESLint, Prettier and `tsc --noEmit` clean on the two files changed in this commit.
- cli: `acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts` passed (1,437 tests) before `main` was merged; not re-run on this head, and the commit does not touch `packages/cli`.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only. macOS 15.6.1.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the match is by call id only. A call with no id, or an id that is not in the history tail, changes nothing, so the transcript is then the same as on `main`. An earlier call with the same command and arguments has a different id and is still listed, since it did run.
- Sub-agents: the classifier history is read from the session chat, while a sub-agent's call comes from its own chat, and call ids are unique only within one chat. The scheduler therefore passes the id only for calls issued by the session chat. For a sub-agent call the transcript is the same as on `main`; its pending call is not in the session history, so there is nothing to skip.
- Not validated / out of scope: the classifier prompt itself is unchanged. #16497 (the classifier treating a goal-related action as authorized) is a separate change. Callers of `classifyAction` other than the scheduler and the ACP session pass no id and behave as before.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. `callId` is an optional field on `PendingAction`, `ClassifierInput` and `EvaluateAutoModeInput`.

prs.body:
## What this PR does

- Stabilizes the merge-relevant Managed Agent check context as `Managed Agent gate` for touched PR fast/full runs, untouched runs, main pushes, and merge groups.
- Keeps touched review runs that select no full suite on the non-required `Managed Agent review (no full run)` context; non-approval and closed-PR reviews still skip, so a no-suite or skipped review cannot overwrite a real fast/full result. A rerun or reopen on a head with an earlier full report also preserves that full result instead of replacing it with fast.
- Extracts tier selection into `.github/scripts/managed-agent-gate-tier.sh`, keeps that script inside the managed-path matcher, and fixes fork review runs whose `pull_requests` list is empty: rerun suppression is SHA-scoped while approval dedup verifies the current PR head SHA/ref against the candidate run branch.
- Updates the workflow meta-test matrix and both Managed Agent gate design documents; the full-run dedup tests now explicitly account for fast-tier runs sharing the required name and fork runs omitting PR metadata.

## Why it's needed

A tier-dependent job name cannot be added safely to the main ruleset: a touched PR reported `Managed Agent fast tier`, while untouched and full-run paths reported `Managed Agent gate`. The change makes the merge-relevant context stable without letting a review that ran no Java publish or overwrite the required context.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Run `npx prettier --check .github/workflows/managed-agent-gate.yml .github/scripts/managed-agent-gate-scope.mjs scripts/tests/managed-agent-gate-workflow.test.js docs/design/2026-10-16-managed-agent-gate.md docs/design/2026-10-16-managed-agent-gate.zh-CN.md`; expect all matched files to pass.
2. Run `bash -n .github/scripts/managed-agent-gate-tier.sh` and `shellcheck .github/scripts/managed-agent-gate-tier.sh`; expect both to pass.
3. Run `WORKFLOW_SIZE_BASE_SHA="$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)" bash .github/scripts/check-workflow-size.sh`; expect the managed gate to stay within its baseline allowance.
4. Run `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/managed-agent-gate-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js`; expect 450 passed and 28 skipped tests (85 in the Managed Agent gate suite).
5. On this PR, confirm the Managed Agent workflow reports the fast-tier result as `Managed Agent gate`, not `Managed Agent fast tier`. A later review that selects no full run must not replace that context.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the fast tier now satisfies the stable required context before the first maintainer approval; the first approval still starts the full suite, and no-suite reviews remain non-required.
- Not validated / out of scope: this PR does not edit the main ruleset; the ruleset now requires `Managed Agent gate`, and this PR's live run is the check-name witness.

prs.title: fix(cli): attribute daemon log lines and bind late channel restores to the boot conflict decline
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Closes the two remaining gaps of the daemon incident report: log-line attribution and channel re-admission after a boot conflict decline. The SSE listener-cap defect (A) was already fixed by #17502 and #17662; the explicit-port fail-fast (B.1) is in #17534; offline occupancy (A.4) is deferred because the reserved listener headroom keeps `/health` reachable.

Daemon log lines become attributable per process: the stderr tee carries `pid=` and, once the listener is up, `port=`; file records gain `port=` after the existing `runId=`/`pid=`. The port is late-bound through a new `DaemonLogger.setPort` called with the actual listening port, so ephemeral port 0 and EADDRINUSE fallback both report the real port; pre-listen records carry pid only. The identity keys (`runId`/`pid`/`port`) are reserved for the daemon prefix in both sinks — a caller's worker pid travels as `childPid` so it stays readable without producing a second, conflicting `pid=` — and a shared identity holder feeds the late-bound port to every stderr line, including the bare write/rotation/retention diagnostics that bypass the tee (the write-failure line an operator greps in a shared sink).

A daemon whose settings-derived channel selection was downgraded at boot because another instance held the channel-service lease no longer re-admits those channels through post-boot workspace registration. The registration hook skips the late restore while the decline stands — before consuming the workspace's once-per-run restore mark, alongside the existing operator-stop skip — so a refused workspace gets its restore back when an explicit selection commit clears the gate and it registers again. The skip restates the boot decline reason (the conflicting holder, sanitized) so it stays diagnosable after the boot warn rotates out on a long-running daemon; it records no failure entry, keeping parity with the operator-stop sibling. The gate excludes the transient "already starting" exclusive-create race (no holder record was ever read), which the runtime lease re-check handles instead. The automatic restore path keeps a defense-in-depth refusal; only a successful explicit selection commit clears the gate, a failed one leaves it set, and starting a single channel independently runs that worker without re-enabling automatic restores. The boot downgrade itself stays non-fatal: settings-derived channels must not block daemon startup.

## Why it's needed

In the reported incident, nine duplicate daemons shared one stdout sink whose lines carried no pid or port, so counter-based diagnosis (SSE opened minus closed) became unattributable once duplicates existed. Separately, a duplicate whose boot channel restore was declined for a lease conflict later ran channel workers anyway: the runtime lease re-check only sees the pidfile's current state, so once the holder's record disappeared (holder exit, stale sweep — the real reader returns null for stale records), a registering workspace's late restore acquired the lease and started side-effecting workers behind the operator's back, while the boot "Continuing without channels" decision was silently reversed. The first implementation of the gate refused after the once-per-run mark was consumed, which permanently spent a refused workspace's restore token and made the documented remedy (explicit commit) silently fail to restore it on re-registration; review caught this and the gate now skips before the mark, matching the operator-stop sibling.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Channel gate behavior suite (new file, 8 cases): `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/channel-boot-downgrade-readmission.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false` — expect 8 passed. Cases: boot conflict downgrade then registration starts no workers (the reproduction, red before the fix); refusal stands while the holder record persists; a non-conflict downgrade still late-restores (gate is conflict-code-specific); an explicit commit clears the gate; the runtime lease re-check refuses independently without a boot downgrade; a refused workspace's restore fires after commit + remove + re-register (the token fix); a failed commit keeps the gate; post-listen file records carry the actual listening port (fixture boots with port 0).
2. Log identity suite: `npx vitest run src/serve/daemon-logger.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false` — expect 65 passed, including tee pid-only → pid+port across `setPort`, file records (info/raw/queue-loss summary) gaining port only after `setPort`, caller ctx pid preserved, stderr-only mode identity.
3. Full channel/boot regression: `npx vitest run src/serve/run-qwen-serve.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false` — expect 567 passed (run with ambient `QWEN_*` unset; a serve session leaks `QWEN_SERVE_CLIENT_MCP_OVER_WS` etc. and reddens one startup-observability case otherwise).
4. Live daemon (bundled): start with a scratch workspace and isolated runtime dir; stderr shows pid-only before listening and pid+port after; the file boot record has no port; a second daemon forced onto the next port by EADDRINUSE logs its real fallback port. For the gate: fixture a live-holder channel-service pidfile record, boot with `serve.channels` configured (downgrade message names the holder), kill the holder, register a non-primary trusted workspace with its own `serve.channels` — expect INFO `skipping serve.channels for a workspace registered after boot: channel hosting was declined at boot`, no channel worker children, no lease re-reservation; then a successful explicit `PUT /workspace/channel` (a credential-free webhook adapter works) clears the gate, and remove + re-register fires the restore.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-UI change (log lines and channel admission). Before: tee lines `[DAEMON] route=… request completed` with no identity; a downgraded duplicate started channel workers on post-boot registration once the holder record vanished. After (live, bundled daemon): `2026-11-20T04:05:50.116Z [INFO] [DAEMON] runId=c0b4d058… pid=2679367 port=43279 workspaceCwd=/tmp/…/secondary skipping serve.channels for a workspace registered after boot: channel hosting was declined at boot`; after a successful commit, remove + re-register logs `restoring serve.channels for a workspace registered after boot` and the secondary worker becomes ready. Two live verification rounds (the second on the review-revised mechanism) plus a 5-mutation matrix (hook gate removal, commit-clear removal, unconditional gate, setPort wiring removal, drop-summary port removal) each killed by exactly its intended tests; the reproduction was deterministically red on the pre-fix tree (3 consecutive runs).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Alibaba Cloud Linux 3 x86_64, Node v26.12.1, vitest 3.2.7; live arms against `node dist/cli.js` (build + bundle from this tree) with isolated `QWEN_HOME`/`QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR` and credential-free webhook adapters; `tsc --build` (8G heap), eslint, prettier clean. Two pre-existing suite reds attributed and unrelated: the ACP-SSE-count case fails identically on the clean base tree (stash A/B, Node 26 environment), and the MCP-drain case is a load-sensitive flake (green in isolation).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the gate could refuse a legitimate late restore. Bounded: it is set only on the real `channel_service_conflict` error code at boot (a transient pidfile write failure does not gate — pinned by a negative control), it clears on a successful explicit commit, and the no-conflict registration path is unchanged (pinned). The refusal is fail-closed: it never hosts more than before, only declines automatic re-admission the boot already refused.
- Not validated / out of scope: a full two-real-daemon E2E with real channel adapters (no credentials; covered by single-daemon live arms with real pidfile/holder/worker-fork, the behavior suite, and mutations); macOS/Windows; offline occupancy (A.4, deferred — headroom keeps `/health` reachable); explicit-port fail-fast (B.1, in #17534). Test-fixture deduplication with the late-registration harness is deferred to the #17554 follow-up hygiene work.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Log identity fields are additive; no production consumer parses the tee shape (the desktop smoke teardown extracts `pid=` from file lines, whose identity prefix is unchanged). Channel refusal only occurs in the conflict-decline window that previously re-admitted workers silently.

## Linked Issues

Refs #17479 (partial: B.2 channel re-admission + B.3 log attribution; defect A fixed by #17502/#17662, B.1 in #17534, A.4 deferred — the issue stays open until those land or are dispositioned)

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

闭合事故报告剩余的两个缺口：日志行归属与 boot 冲突降级后的 channel 重新准入。SSE listener 上限缺陷（A）已由 #17502/#17662 修复；显式端口 fail-fast（B.1）在 #17534；离线占用（A.4）暂缓——预留余量已保证 `/health` 恒可达。

daemon 日志行按进程可归属：stderr tee 带 `pid=`，监听后带 `port=`；文件行在既有 `runId=`/`pid=` 后新增 `port=`。端口经新增的 `DaemonLogger.setPort` 以实际监听端口迟绑定，临时端口 0 与 EADDRINUSE 回退都报真实端口；监听前记录仅带 pid。身份键（runId/pid/port）在两个 sink 中都保留给 daemon 前缀——调用方的 worker pid 以 `childPid` 传递，既可读又不产生第二个冲突的 `pid=`——共享 identity holder 把迟绑定端口喂给所有 stderr 行，包括绕过 tee 的裸写/轮转/保留诊断（共享 sink 里运维 grep 的写失败行）。

boot 时因另一实例持有 channel-service 租约而降级的 settings 派生选择，不再经 boot 后工作区注册重新准入。注册钩子在降级存续期内跳过 late restore——在消耗该工作区「每运行一次」恢复名额之前、与既有 operator-stop 跳过并列——因此被拒工作区在显式提交清门后重新注册能拿回恢复。跳过行复述 boot 拒绝原因（冲突方，已脱敏），长期运行 daemon 的 boot warn 轮转掉后仍可诊断；不写失败记录，与 operator-stop 兄弟一致。门控排除瞬时「already starting」独占创建竞争（从未读到 holder 记录），交由运行时租约重检处理。自动恢复路径保留纵深防御拒绝；仅成功的显式选区提交清门，失败提交保门，独立启动单个 channel 会运行该 worker 但不重新启用自动恢复。boot 降级本身仍非致命：settings 派生 channel 不得阻止 daemon 启动。

## 为什么需要

事故中九个副本 daemon 共享一个 stdout sink，行内无 pid/port，副本出现后基于计数器的诊断（SSE opened 减 closed）无法归属。另一方面，boot 因租约冲突被拒的副本后来仍跑起了 channel worker：运行时租约重检只看 pidfile 当前状态，holder 记录消失后（holder 退出、stale 清扫——真实读取器对 stale 记录返回 null），注册工作区的 late restore 取得租约并在运维背后启动副作用 worker，boot 的「Continuing without channels」决定被静默推翻。门控的第一版实现在名额消耗之后拒绝，永久花费被拒工作区的恢复令牌，使文档补救（显式提交）在重新注册时静默失效；评审抓住此点，门控现在打标前跳过，与 operator-stop 兄弟一致。

## 评审验证计划

见英文部分：8 用例行为套件（含复现 red→green、名额恢复、失败提交保门、端口接线）、65 用例日志身份套件、567 用例 boot/channel 全量回归（剥离环境泄漏变量）、bundled daemon 两轮 live 验证（第二轮用免凭据 webhook 适配器实机演示成功提交清门 + 名额恢复）、5 变异矩阵各被其目标测试杀死。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：门控可能拒绝合法 late restore。有界：仅 boot 真实 `channel_service_conflict` 错误码置位（瞬时 pidfile 写失败不置门——负向对照钉住），成功显式提交清门，无冲突注册路径不变（钉住）。拒绝方向 fail-closed：只会少托管，不会多托管。
- 未验证/范围外：双真实 daemon + 真实适配器完整 E2E（无凭据；单 daemon 实机 + 行为套件 + 变异覆盖）；macOS/Windows；A.4 离线占用（暂缓）；B.1（#17534）。测试夹具去重延至 #17554 后续整洁工作。
- 破坏性变更：无。日志身份字段 additive；无生产消费方解析 tee 形状（desktop smoke teardown 从文件行提取 `pid=`，身份前缀未变）。channel 拒绝仅发生在此前静默重新准入的冲突降级窗口。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #17479（部分：B.2 + B.3；A 已由 #17502/#17662 修复，B.1 在 #17534，A.4 暂缓——issue 保持开放直至那些落地或处置）

</details>
