prs.title: refactor(managed-agent): drop redundant in-process locks and the archived legacy Session guard stub
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Removes three pieces of redundant in-process locking and dead guard code from the managed agent server, with no change to lock order, SQL statements, or transaction boundaries.

- The external Runtime provisioner kept its placements in concurrent maps, but every compound access already ran under a single monitor on those maps, and one read skipped the monitor. The maps are now plain maps guarded by that one monitor, and the read that skipped it now takes it, so every access follows the same rule.
- The Runtime Broker's per-Session context took its reentrant guard inside every getter, although every getter is called from inside a region where the caller already holds that guard. For the background-process set the inner lock protected nothing, because it returned the live mutable set to a caller who then changed it outside that inner lock. The getters now read directly under the caller's lock. The writers keep taking the guard because some of them run from completion callbacks that hold no lock.
- When the resident CSI backend and its legacy Session guard were archived (#17415), the guard entry point was left as an empty method still called from twelve Turn, event, and command paths, together with an unused flag and two "legacy"-named aliases that only forwarded to the ordinary Session row lock and Session+Turn row lock. These are removed and the callers use the ordinary lock methods directly.

## Why it's needed

This came out of a review of over-defensive locking in the module. None of the three changes alters behavior. They take out layers that a reader has to reason about without getting any protection from them: concurrent maps that are never accessed concurrently, nested acquisitions of a lock the caller already holds, and calls named like a guard that no longer guards anything. In particular, the empty legacy guard calls suggested that Turn lease, retry, and event-recording paths still took an extra Session lock, which they have not done since the archive.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Confirm that each per-Session context getter is called only inside a lock region of that context, and that the writers called from completion callbacks (control counters, release futures, mount claim) still take the guard themselves.
- Confirm that every read and write of the external provisioner's two placement maps now happens under the placements monitor.
- Confirm that the removed legacy guard method had an empty body on main, and that the removed aliases forwarded to exactly the methods their callers now use, so the SQL each path issues is unchanged.

Local evidence (JDK 21.0.13, Maven 3.10.0, H2): the focused suites for the external Runtime and workspace provisioners, the Runtime Broker service, Broker virtual-thread pinning, managed Turn commands, Session lifecycle, and the schema Session store ran 336 tests with 336 passing. Checkstyle passed on the reactor, and SpotBugs passed on the runtime-broker and runtime-external modules and their upstream modules.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (refactor, no user-visible change).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A: Maven unit and H2 suites only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a future getter call made outside the Session context's lock would read the context's state without synchronization. The guard's comment now states that getters are called only inside a caller's lock region.
- Not validated / out of scope: the full `mvn verify` run, SpotBugs on the persistence module, and the MySQL and Hosted profiles were not run locally and are left to CI. No SQL changed, so no MySQL-specific behavior is expected to change. SQL-level locking candidates from the same review (locking reads used only to read current rows, and the "upsert then lock" pattern) are not part of this PR because they need MySQL lock evidence first. Historical design documents that mention the removed names are left unchanged as records of past state.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #17415.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

从 managed agent server 中去掉三处多余的进程内加锁和失效的 guard 代码。锁顺序、SQL 语句和事务边界都没有变。

- External Runtime provisioner 用并发 map 保存 placement，但所有复合操作本来就在同一个 monitor 下执行，只有一处读取没加这个 monitor。现在两个 map 改为普通 map，由这一个 monitor 保护，原先漏加锁的那处读取也补上了，所有访问遵循同一条规则。
- Runtime Broker 的每 Session 上下文在每个 getter 里都会获取自己的可重入 guard，但所有 getter 都是在调用方已经持有该 guard 的区域内调用的。对 background process 集合而言，内层锁什么也没保护：它把可变集合直接返回给调用方，调用方随后在这把内层锁之外修改集合。现在 getter 直接在调用方的锁下读取。写方法继续自己获取 guard，因为其中一部分在不持锁的完成回调中执行。
- 在 resident CSI 后端及其 legacy Session guard 被归档时（#17415），guard 的入口被留成一个空方法，仍有 12 个 Turn、事件和命令路径在调用；同时还留下一个没有用到的参数，以及两个带 "legacy" 字样、只是转发到普通 Session 行锁和 Session+Turn 行锁的别名方法。本 PR 删除它们，调用方直接使用普通的加锁方法。

## 为什么需要

这些改动来自对该模块过度防御式加锁的一次审查。三处改动都不改变行为。它们删掉的是读代码时需要推敲、却不提供任何保护的层次：从不会被并发访问的并发 map、对调用方已持有的锁的嵌套获取，以及名字像 guard、实际上已不再保护任何东西的调用。特别是那些空的 legacy guard 调用，会让人以为 Turn 租约、重试和事件记录路径还在额外获取一把 Session 锁，而自归档以来它们已不再如此。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 确认每 Session 上下文的每个 getter 都只在该上下文的加锁区域内被调用，并确认在完成回调中调用的写方法（control 计数、release future、mount claim）仍然自己获取 guard。
- 确认 external provisioner 两个 placement map 的每一次读写现在都在 placements monitor 下进行。
- 确认被删除的 legacy guard 方法在 main 上方法体为空，被删除的别名方法转发到的正是调用方现在直接使用的方法，因此各路径发出的 SQL 不变。

本地证据（JDK 21.0.13、Maven 3.10.0、H2）：External Runtime 与 workspace provisioner、Runtime Broker service、Broker 虚拟线程 pinning、managed Turn 命令、Session 生命周期和 schema Session store 的聚焦测试共运行 336 个用例，全部通过。整个 reactor 的 Checkstyle 通过；runtime-broker、runtime-external 两个模块及其上游模块的 SpotBugs 通过。

### 证据（前后对比）

不适用（重构，无用户可见变化）。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

不适用：仅 Maven 单元测试和 H2 测试。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：如果将来有人在 Session 上下文的锁之外调用 getter，会在没有同步的情况下读取上下文状态。guard 的注释现在写明了 getter 只在调用方的加锁区域内调用。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：完整的 `mvn verify`、persistence 模块的 SpotBugs，以及 MySQL 和 Hosted profile 未在本地运行，交由 CI。本 PR 没有改动 SQL，因此不应有 MySQL 特有的行为变化。同一次审查中 SQL 层面的候选项（只为读取最新数据而使用的加锁读，以及“upsert 后再加锁读”模式）不在本 PR 范围内，它们需要先拿到 MySQL 上的锁证据。引用了被删除名称的历史设计文档保持不变，作为过去状态的记录。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

#17415 的后续。

prs.title: refactor(managed-agent): drop redundant storage keys
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Removes two redundant unique keys from the managed storage coordination tables, following the bilingual design included in this PR. The storage alias table drops its hashed tenant and storage columns and the unique key built on them, because the alias key already identifies the same tenant/storage pair. The storage fence read now finds the row through the alias key and still re-checks the raw tenant and storage identities, and the external materialization check filters on the raw identities it has already locked. The physical owner table drops its physical-key column and unique key, because every writer stores the same canonical physical identity there and in the owner's business key. Owner lookups lose the duplicate predicate, and every byte-exact comparison that read the dropped column now compares against the business key instead of being removed. Test fixtures stop writing the dropped columns. The two tests that simulated a divergence between the owner's two columns now drift the alias mapping instead, the only divergence still representable, and still fail closed.

## Why it's needed

Both tables carry a second unique key that names exactly the same rows as the business key. The alias table inherited both keys when two legacy tables were consolidated, and the owner table's two columns hold the same value on every write path. Each extra key costs a column, a unique index, an extra duplicate check on every insert, and a second index path that can lock the same row. That second path is a real hazard: an earlier deadlock (#16320) came from locking an alias row through the hashed tenant/storage key while other transactions locked it through the alias key, and two owner reads that take row locks currently let the optimizer choose either owner unique index. After this change each row has exactly one unique lookup path. This is the follow-up deferred from #17927, which removed hash keys of the same redundant kind that sat off the coordination paths.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Recreate a development catalog from the edited V1 baseline on H2 and MySQL 8.4. Confirm the alias table has no `tenant_key`, `storage_key` or `uk_ma_storage_alias`, and the owner table has no `physical_key` or `uk_ma_storage_owner_physical`.
- Exercise storage fencing (requesting a fence, querying it, admission refused while fenced, a migration abort clearing the fence): behaviour is unchanged, and a fence on one tenant/storage alias does not affect another.
- Register local, SSH and external storage and materialize an external workspace: registration, owner checks and duplicate-registration conflicts behave as before.
- Point an alias at a physical identity that has no owner row: admission and verification refuse it.
- On MySQL, run `EXPLAIN` on the storage fence read and on the two owner `FOR UPDATE` reads: they should use `uk_ma_storage_business_key` and `uk_ma_storage_owner_business_key` respectively.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (schema refactor; no user-visible change).

Local verification (H2, JDK 21, Maven 3.9.9):

- After the alias-table commit: 21 focused test classes, `Tests run: 471, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0`; Checkstyle (both executions) 0 violations.
- After the owner-table commit: the first run of 20 focused classes caught one missed read site in the external physical admission check (3 errors in `ExternalWorkspaceMaterializationTest`). After the fix, the external-path classes plus the classes the first commit had covered ran `335/335`, and the storage-fence consumers (`WorkspaceMigrationRepositoryTest`, `RuntimeHarnessDrainTest`, `ManagedAgentApiContractTest`, `ManagedActionsTest`) ran `152/152`. Checkstyle 0 violations.
- Mutation checks, all caught: binding a wrong alias into the storage fence read (2 failures), comparing the owner check against the wrong column (14 failures), and removing the drift step from the two drift tests (both fail).
- One failure unrelated to this change: a `ManagedSessionStoreIntegrationTest` case needs built TypeScript core output that the fresh worktree did not have (`ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`). Left to CI.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux, JDK 21, Maven 3.9.9 offline, reusing an installed `qwencode-sdk` whose sources match the branch; H2 embedded catalog for the focused tests. No MySQL server was available.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the changed statements sit on storage coordination paths. Lock targets and lock order do not change, and each row now has a single unique lock path, but the changed statements still need MySQL race evidence. About 30 test files change mechanically; the only semantic test change is the retargeting of the two drift tests, which keep their fail-closed assertions.
- Not validated / out of scope: the MySQL integration tests for storage row lock order, lock scope concurrency, workspace migration, tool publication storage, workspace query scale and schema shape, and the Hosted monitor fault gate, have not run locally (no MySQL). Acceptance is pending CI full tier or a disposable MySQL 8.4 run, including the `EXPLAIN` evidence above. Per the design, that evidence is one-off and no new permanent plan assertion is added. The alias key and the owner business key themselves stay; replacing them with raw columns belongs to the identity de-hash.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: pre-release policy applies. The single V1 baseline is edited in place and development catalogs are recreated; there is no V2+ migration. Recovery evidence recorded before the change includes the dropped owner column and would not compare equal after it, which catalog recreation makes moot. No public API or serialized payload change.

Design document (both languages, complete and synchronized): [English](docs/design/2026-11-20-managed-storage-redundant-keys.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-20-managed-storage-redundant-keys.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #17927, which recorded these two removals as deferred. Related: #16320.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做什么

按本 PR 附带的双语设计，删除 managed storage 协调表上两个冗余的唯一键。storage alias 表删除哈希过的 tenant 与 storage 列及基于它们的唯一键，因为 alias 键已经标识同一个 tenant/storage 组合。storage fence 读取改为通过 alias 键定位行，并继续复核原始 tenant 与 storage 身份；外部物化检查改为按它已经锁住的原始身份过滤。physical owner 表删除 physical-key 列及其唯一键，因为每个写入方都在这一列和 owner 业务键里存同一个 canonical physical identity。owner 查询去掉重复的谓词；所有读取被删列的字节精确比较都改为与业务键比较，而不是删除。测试 fixture 不再写被删的列。原先模拟 owner 两列不一致的两个测试，改为让 alias 映射漂移（这是唯一仍可能出现的不一致），并且仍然 fail closed。

## 为什么需要

两张表各带一个与业务键识别完全相同行的第二唯一键。alias 表是在合并两张旧表时继承了两套键；owner 表的两列在每条写路径上都存同一个值。每个多余的键都要付出一列、一个唯一索引、每次插入多一次重复检查，以及一条可以锁住同一行的第二条索引路径。这条第二路径确实是隐患：此前的一次死锁（#16320）就是因为一边通过哈希的 tenant/storage 键锁 alias 行，另一边的事务通过 alias 键锁同一行；而当前有两处会加行锁的 owner 读取，允许优化器在两个 owner 唯一索引中任选其一。改动后每一行只有一条唯一查找路径。这是 #17927 延后的后续工作；#17927 删除的是同类冗余、但不在协调路径上的哈希键。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 在 H2 与 MySQL 8.4 上从编辑后的 V1 基线重建开发 catalog。确认 alias 表没有 `tenant_key`、`storage_key` 或 `uk_ma_storage_alias`，owner 表没有 `physical_key` 或 `uk_ma_storage_owner_physical`。
- 走一遍 storage fence（申请 fence、查询 fence、fence 期间拒绝准入、迁移中止清除 fence）：行为不变，且一个 tenant/storage alias 上的 fence 不影响其他 alias。
- 注册本地、SSH 与外部存储，并物化一个外部 workspace：注册、owner 检查与重复注册冲突的行为与之前一致。
- 让某个 alias 指向一个没有 owner 行的 physical identity：准入与校验都会拒绝。
- 在 MySQL 上对 storage fence 读取和两处 owner `FOR UPDATE` 读取执行 `EXPLAIN`：应分别使用 `uk_ma_storage_business_key` 与 `uk_ma_storage_owner_business_key`。

### 证据（Before & After）

N/A（schema 重构；无用户可见变化）。

本地验证（H2，JDK 21，Maven 3.9.9）：

- alias 表提交之后：21 个聚焦测试类，`Tests run: 471, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0`；Checkstyle（两个 execution）0 违规。
- owner 表提交之后：首轮 20 个聚焦测试类抓到外部物理准入检查中一处漏改的读取点（`ExternalWorkspaceMaterializationTest` 3 个错误）。修复后，外部路径相关类加上第一个提交覆盖过的类共 `335/335` 通过，storage fence 的消费方（`WorkspaceMigrationRepositoryTest`、`RuntimeHarnessDrainTest`、`ManagedAgentApiContractTest`、`ManagedActionsTest`）`152/152` 通过。Checkstyle 0 违规。
- 变异校验全部被抓到：storage fence 读取绑定错误的 alias（2 个失败）、owner 检查改为与错误的列比较（14 个失败）、去掉两个漂移测试中制造漂移的步骤（两个测试都失败）。
- 一个与本改动无关的失败：`ManagedSessionStoreIntegrationTest` 的一个用例需要已构建的 TypeScript core 产物，而新 worktree 中没有（`ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`）。留给 CI。

### 测试平台

macOS ⚠️；Windows ⚠️；Linux ✅。

### 环境

Linux，JDK 21，Maven 3.9.9 离线模式，复用源码与分支一致的已安装 `qwencode-sdk`；聚焦测试使用 H2 内嵌 catalog。该环境没有 MySQL。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：改动的语句位于 storage 协调路径上。锁目标与锁序不变，且每一行现在只有一条唯一的加锁路径，但改动的语句仍需要 MySQL 竞态证据。约 30 个测试文件被机械修改；唯一的语义性测试改动是两个漂移测试的改写，它们保留了 fail-closed 断言。
- 未验证/范围外：storage 行锁序、锁范围并发、workspace 迁移、tool publication storage、workspace 查询规模与 schema 形状的 MySQL 集成测试，以及 Hosted monitor 故障门，都没有在本地运行（无 MySQL）。验收待 CI 完整检查或一次性 MySQL 8.4 补跑，包括上面的 `EXPLAIN` 证据。按设计，这些证据是一次性的，不新增永久的执行计划断言。alias 键与 owner 业务键本身保留；把它们换成原始列属于身份去哈希的工作。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：适用 release 前政策。原地编辑单一 V1 基线并重建开发 catalog；没有 V2+ 迁移。改动前记录的恢复证据包含被删除的 owner 列，改动后比对不会相等，重建 catalog 后这一点不再相关。无公共 API 或序列化 payload 变化。

设计文档（双语、完整同步）：[English](docs/design/2026-11-20-managed-storage-redundant-keys.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-20-managed-storage-redundant-keys.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

#17927 的后续工作，#17927 已把这两项删除记录为延后。相关：#16320。

</details>

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): load transport wakes through the passive verb
prs.body:
## What this PR does

An EventTransport wake notice for a Session nobody holds now loads that Session through the same passive load the backstop wake scan uses, instead of the active load it took until now. The fence checks before the load, the claim, the load pool, the owner-side subscription after a successful load and the reading of a failed load from SQL are all unchanged. Only the load verb differs.

The active verb existed to cope with two situations a passive load does not have. A cached attachment left behind by a sealed writer could make the load report "already attached" and strand the wake, so the verb evicted it first. A Session a previous control-plane process had attached answered a plain load with "already attached", so the verb re-attached it through the takeover load. A passive load always makes the round trip and is answered from a resident Session, so neither case arises, and the "already attached" load outcome is removed.

The seal-time wake stamp addendum is updated in both languages: its transport section no longer says the transport keeps the active verb.

## Why it's needed

The control-plane wake design (§4.2 step 3) requires every wake load to be passive. The active verb's takeover load and its new-work attachment can drive Runtime recovery for a crashed Session, which may re-run an in-flight foreground tool through the Broker or advance an unrelated foreground Turn. A wake only needs the Session loaded so its wake pump runs the due input; a crashed Session's foreground Turn belongs to its existing coordination flow. The backstop already loads passively, and #17908 left the transport on the active verb as a follow-up. This PR completes that follow-up, so the two wake paths load the same way.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- A wake notice for an unowned Session is still claimed on the listener thread and loaded off it, and the load is now the passive one; the active verb is never called.
- A notice the fence refuses (a live writer, a settled Session, a stamped head not yet due, an unknown or foreign Session, an unavailable Harness) and a notice dropped by a full load pool still load nothing.
- A failed load is still reported as fenced only when SQL then shows another live writer, and as failed otherwise.
- The SQL consumer cases (redelivered and older wakes, stamped heads, a sealed journal with a leftover lease) load exactly as many times as before, on H2 and on MySQL.
- In the multi-node and broker gates, a successful load is still reported as activated.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (no UI change). Local verification output is posted as a separate comment.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

macOS 13 x86_64, JDK 21.0.13, Maven 3.10.0, MySQL 8.4.2 (local, binary log off, `max_allowed_packet` 128 MiB).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: in the narrow race where another path attaches the Session while a wake load is queued, the transport used to report "already attached" and do nothing; it now makes one passive round trip, which the Harness answers from the resident Session, and subscribes the owner lane, which is idempotent. The backstop already behaves this way.
- Not validated / out of scope: the RocketMQ broker and multi-node gates, the Hosted failover and fault gates, SpotBugs and `mvn verify` run in CI; the gates' test sources were compiled locally but not run. Locally, MySQL ran on 8.4.2 without the Linux-only native-AIO flag, while CI uses 8.4.6. The active verb now has no production caller; it is left in place because its connector tests also cover the attachment cache's identity rules alongside the passive verb, and removing it is a separate cleanup.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #17908 (slice (1) of the design in #17869; parent design #17805).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

对于无人持有的 Session，EventTransport 的 wake 通知现在通过兜底 wake 扫描所用的同一个被动加载来加载该 Session，而不再使用此前的主动加载。加载前的围栏检查、认领、加载线程池、加载成功后的 owner 侧订阅，以及加载失败后从 SQL 判断结果的方式都不变，只有加载动词不同。

主动动词是为了应对两种被动加载不会遇到的情况。由已 seal 的 writer 留下的缓存 attachment 可能让加载报告"已 attach"，从而让 wake 卡住，所以该动词会先把它移除。之前某个控制面进程 attach 过的 Session 对普通加载会回答"已 attach"，所以该动词会通过接管加载重新 attach。被动加载总会完成一次往返，并由驻留中的 Session 作答，因此这两种情况都不会出现，"已 attach"这一加载结果也随之删除。

seal 时 wake 戳补充设计的中英文版本都已更新：其 transport 一节不再写 transport 仍使用主动动词。

## 为什么需要

控制面 wake 设计（§4.2 第 3 步）要求所有 wake 加载都是被动的。主动动词的接管加载和新工作 attach 可能为已崩溃的 Session 驱动 Runtime 恢复，从而经 Broker 重新执行进行中的前台工具，或推进一个无关的前台 Turn。wake 只需要把 Session 加载起来，让它的唤醒泵运行到期输入；已崩溃 Session 的前台 Turn 归其现有的协调流程处理。兜底扫描本来就是被动加载，#17908 把 transport 留在主动动词上作为后续项。本 PR 完成这一后续项，使两条 wake 路径以相同方式加载。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 无人持有的 Session 的 wake 通知仍在监听线程上认领、在其外加载，现在加载走被动动词，主动动词从不被调用。
- 被围栏拒绝的通知（有 live writer、Session 已结算、带戳 head 尚未到期、未知或不属于该 workspace 的 Session、Harness 不可用），以及因加载线程池已满而被丢弃的通知，仍然不加载任何东西。
- 加载失败时，只有在 SQL 随后显示另一个 live writer 时才报告为 fenced，否则报告为 failed。
- SQL consumer 的各用例（重复投递和更旧的 wake、带戳 head、带有残留租约的已 seal journal）在 H2 和 MySQL 上的加载次数与之前完全相同。
- 在多节点和 broker 门禁中，成功的加载仍报告为 activated。

### 证据（前后对比）

不适用（没有 UI 变化）。本地验证输出单独以评论形式发布。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

macOS 13 x86_64、JDK 21.0.13、Maven 3.10.0、MySQL 8.4.2（本地，关闭 binary log，`max_allowed_packet` 128 MiB）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：在 wake 加载排队期间另一路径 attach 了该 Session 这一狭窄竞态中，transport 以前报告"已 attach"且什么都不做；现在它会做一次被动往返，由驻留中的 Session 作答，并订阅 owner 通道，这一订阅是幂等的。兜底扫描本来就是这样的行为。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：RocketMQ broker 与多节点门禁、Hosted failover 与故障门禁、SpotBugs 和 `mvn verify` 在 CI 中运行；这些门禁的测试源码已在本地编译，但未运行。本地 MySQL 版本为 8.4.2，且没有仅限 Linux 的 native AIO 参数，而 CI 使用 8.4.6。主动动词现在没有生产调用方；之所以保留，是因为它的 connector 测试与被动动词一起覆盖了 attachment 缓存的身份规则，删除它是另一项独立的清理。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

#17908 的后续（#17869 中设计的第 (1) 批；父设计 #17805）。

</details>

prs.title: test(managed-agent): run the wake stamp suites on MySQL and pin each suspension gate clause
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This closes the test gaps that the review of #17908 left open for the seal-time wake stamp. It changes no behavior.

The stamp, the acquire-time cap and the backstop's stamped selection now also run on MySQL 8.4. The two H2 suites that cover them could only build an H2 database, so the `mysql-integration` profile never ran them; each suite now takes its data source from an overridable hook, as the existing wake-recovery store suite does, and a MySQL subclass runs every case against an isolated MySQL database. The transport's stamped arms already ran on MySQL through their existing subclass.

The Harness's relaxed suspension gate is now a single named predicate, called by the gate exactly as before, with one test per blocking clause: a non-wake input, a stopped run's message, an immediate input, an input due now, and an input a transcript attempt already touched each keep the Session resident, while a deferred, unattempted wake input does not. Before this, the five clauses were an inline disjunction, and only the admitting path and the capability-off path had tests, so any one clause could be dropped without a test failing.

The Store client gains a test for each renewal path: an ordinary writer renewal and an activation renewal both pick up a change in the `wakeDispatch` capability.

## Why it's needed

The addendum's acceptance (§7) requires the stamp, the acquire cap and the backstop branch to pass on MySQL 8.4 and states that H2 alone is not acceptance. #17908 merged before its full tier ran, and even a full run would not have exercised these cases, because they had no MySQL variant. All four reviews of #17908 also flagged the gate's untested blocking clauses and the untested renewal refresh as follow-ups.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- The two new MySQL suites run under `mysql-integration` and pass every case their H2 parents pass: the stamped seal and its revision fence, the bare seal, the acquire cap that never lowers a claim delay, the stamped child Session, and the 128 far-future heads that cause no claim and no journal read while a due Session is selected stamped.
- Each blocking clause of the gate has its own failing case: removing the source, stopped-message, due-time or prior-attempt check from the predicate turns exactly that case red. The `notBefore !== null` check only narrows the type for the comparison after it, since an immediate input already fails `notBefore > now`.
- Flipping the capability on the fake Store between renewals is reflected by the client after an ordinary writer renewal and after an activation renewal.
- The gate's call site is unchanged in effect: it still blocks when any pending input is not owned by the control plane's due-time dispatch, and the existing capability-on and capability-off suspension tests still pass.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (tests only, plus a behavior-preserving extraction). Local verification output is posted as a separate comment.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

macOS 13 x86_64, JDK 21.0.13, Maven 3.10.0, MySQL 8.4.2 (local, binary log off, `max_allowed_packet` 128 MiB), Node 22.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the gate's condition moved out of the suspension callback. The original disjunction is now written as a negated conjunction, so the gate's result is unchanged for every input.
- Not validated / out of scope: the full `mysql-integration` profile, SpotBugs and `mvn verify` run in CI. Locally, MySQL ran on 8.4.2 without the Linux-only native-AIO flag, while CI uses 8.4.6. A recovery-view case for a stamped child Session is not added: the recovery view never reads the Session's kind, so a child fixture would be identical to the existing public-Session case. The rollback arm has no server-side case of its own: the wake-dispatch flag is read only where the writer grant is built, so a stamped head is delivered by the same backstop code whether the flag is on or off, and that path is already covered.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #17908 (implements slice (1) of the design in #17869).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

本 PR 补上 #17908 评审中留下的 seal 时 wake 戳测试缺口，不改变任何行为。

戳、获取时的上限和兜底扫描对带戳 head 的选择，现在也会在 MySQL 8.4 上运行。覆盖它们的两个 H2 测试类原来只能构建 H2 数据库，所以 `mysql-integration` profile 从未运行过它们；现在两个测试类都通过一个可覆盖的钩子获取数据源，与现有的 wake 恢复 store 测试类一致，再由一个 MySQL 子类在隔离的 MySQL 数据库上运行全部用例。transport 的带戳分支此前已经通过现有子类在 MySQL 上运行。

Harness 放宽后的挂起门现在是一个具名谓词，门的调用方式与之前完全相同，并为每个阻止挂起的条件各配一个用例：非 wake 输入、已停止 run 的消息、立即投递的输入、已到期的输入，以及已被 transcript 尝试过的输入，都会让 Session 保持驻留；而一个延后、未尝试的 wake 输入不会。此前这五个条件是一个内联析取式，只有放行路径和能力关闭路径有测试，删掉其中任一条件都不会有测试失败。

Store 客户端为两条续租路径各新增一个用例：普通的 writer 续租和 activation 续租都会获取 `wakeDispatch` 能力的变化。

## 为什么需要

补充设计的验收标准（§7）要求戳、获取上限和兜底分支在 MySQL 8.4 上通过，并写明仅 H2 不构成验收。#17908 在其完整测试档运行之前就已合并，而且即使完整档运行了，也不会覆盖这些用例，因为它们没有 MySQL 变体。#17908 的四份评审也都把挂起门未测试的阻止条件和续租刷新列为后续项。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 两个新的 MySQL 测试类在 `mysql-integration` 下运行，并通过其 H2 父类通过的全部用例：带戳 seal 及其 revision 围栏、裸 seal、从不降低认领延迟的获取上限、带戳的子 Session，以及 128 个远期 head 不引起认领、不读 journal，同时已到期的 Session 以带戳方式被选中。
- 挂起门的每个阻止条件都有自己的失败用例：从谓词中删掉 source、停止消息、到期时间或已尝试检查中的任一项，恰好让对应用例变红。`notBefore !== null` 检查只为其后的比较收窄类型，因为立即投递的输入本来就不满足 `notBefore > now`。
- 在两次续租之间切换 fake Store 的能力，客户端在普通 writer 续租和 activation 续租之后都能反映出来。
- 挂起门的调用点在效果上不变：只要有任一待处理输入不归控制面的到期分发所有，它仍然阻止挂起；现有的能力开启与关闭挂起测试仍然通过。

### 证据（前后对比）

不适用（只有测试，外加一处保持行为不变的提取）。本地验证输出单独以评论形式发布。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

macOS 13 x86_64、JDK 21.0.13、Maven 3.10.0、MySQL 8.4.2（本地，关闭 binary log，`max_allowed_packet` 128 MiB）、Node 22。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：挂起门的条件从挂起回调中移出。原来的析取式现在写成一个取反的合取式，因此对每个输入，挂起门的结果都不变。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：完整的 `mysql-integration` profile、SpotBugs 和 `mvn verify` 在 CI 中运行。本地 MySQL 版本为 8.4.2，且没有仅限 Linux 的 native AIO 参数，而 CI 使用 8.4.6。没有新增带戳子 Session 的恢复视图用例：恢复视图从不读取 Session 的类型，子 Session 的用例会与现有的公共 Session 用例完全相同。回滚分支没有单独的服务端用例：wake 分发开关只在构建 writer grant 时读取，因此无论开关开或关，带戳的 head 都由同一段兜底代码投递，而这条路径已有覆盖。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

#17908 的后续（实现 #17869 中设计的第 (1) 批）。

</details>

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): create the ephemeral Runtime state directory before spawning
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Creates the ephemeral Runtime state directory before the worker process is spawned. `LocalRuntimeProviderFactory.create` now makes `RuntimeBrokerSettings.state-directory` when the ephemeral provisioner path is in use (`durable-local-process=false`); the durable path is untouched because `LocalRuntimeStore` already guarantees that directory. No retry policy, assertion or timeout was changed.

This fixes one hosted-lane failure class that no open PR covers. The MySQL-lane classes that also redden the same gate are deliberately not touched here: `ManagedWorkspaceArtifactMySqlIT.theWorkspacePagePredicateHasAnIndexAccessPath` is covered by #17893, and `WorkspaceCreationSchemaMySqlIT.preservesReceiptsAndModelConstraintsAcrossRestart` is covered by #17917. I reproduced and verified both before deciding to leave them out.

## Why it's needed

`SDK Java` has been red nightly on `main` since 2026-11-11 and now blocks the required `Managed Agent gate`. `HostedAutomationSpringCrashIT` (4/5), `HostedPublicWorkspaceIT` and `HostedWorkspaceToolTurnIT` all reported the same opaque symptom:

```
warm turn completed timed out; harness log: qwen serve: --managed-runtime-broker-token is visible …
```

The root cause is one missing directory. `LocalProcessRuntimeProvisioner` spawns each worker with `RuntimeBrokerSettings.state-directory` as the process working directory, and the ephemeral provisioner — what all hosted fixtures use — has no store to create it, while `LocalRuntimeProviderFactory.create` never created it either. `ProcessBuilder.start()` therefore failed immediately:

```
java.io.IOException: Cannot run program "/usr/local/bin/node" (in directory "…/fire/runtime"):
  Exec failed, error: 2 (No such file or directory)
```

The provisioner mapped that IOException to a non-retryable `runtime_provision_failed` ("Managed context startup failed; recovery is blocked."), and `HarnessCoordinator.prepareRuntime` kept retrying it until the `harness.load-timeout` ceiling, surfacing `runtime_preparation_timeout`. The warm turn never ran, and the reported failure was about a timeout rather than the missing directory.

The same path explains the "Run long-answer persistence E2E" failover failure: its second (big-output) turn warms a fresh binding through the ephemeral path and dies the same way, reporting `runtime_preparation_timeout` at `HarnessCoordinator.java:1245` (#17851).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the hosted fixtures that were failing and confirm the warm turn now executes instead of hitting the load-timeout ceiling. Locally I reproduced on MySQL 8.4.11 with the bundled `dist/cli.js` and `-Dspotbugs.skip=true` — the `origin/main` SpotBugs NP_NULL_ON_SOME_PATH is #17921's fix, not this one — and ran `HostedAutomationSpringCrashIT#fg11c2ScannerFiresOneOccurrenceOnMySql` before and after this change alone, then `WorkspaceCreationSchemaMySqlIT` plus `ManagedWorkspaceArtifactMySqlIT` on a clean schema.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: `HostedAutomationSpringCrashIT#fg11c2ScannerFiresOneOccurrenceOnMySql` fails after 120 s with `warm turn completed timed out`, identical to CI.

After: the same test passes in 31 s with this change alone. `WorkspaceCreationSchemaMySqlIT` + `ManagedWorkspaceArtifactMySqlIT`: 19/19 on a clean schema.

Not verified: CI on this head, including the "Run long-answer persistence E2E" failover job — that job is the one this fix is also expected to clear, and it has not run yet.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   N/A  |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

⚠️ Windows not tested here: the `windows-latest` `ExternalShellWorkerProtocolTest.copiesALargeCaptureBlockByBlockWithoutLosingOrReorderingBytes` failure was already fixed upstream by `2ebaac20284be` (large captures are staged to disk) and the red run predates it; #17891 also targets that fixture.

### Environment (optional)

Linux, JDK 21, MySQL 8.4.11, bundled `dist/cli.js`, `-Dspotbugs.skip=true`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the ephemeral path now performs one extra `mkdir` before spawn; the durable path, the retry policy and every timeout are unchanged, so the only behavioral difference is that a spawn which previously failed immediately now proceeds.
- Not validated: CI on this head has not run; specifically the failover job that this change is also expected to clear.
- Breaking changes: none.

## Linked Issues

#17851 (the long-answer persistence failover failure explained above). Not fixed here, tracked elsewhere: #17893 and #17917 for the two MySQL-lane test defects, #17921 for the `origin/main` SpotBugs finding, #17891 for the Windows fixture, #16003 for the runner disk floor and the `tee` panic (infrastructure, not code).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

**这张 PR 做什么**：在 spawn worker 之前创建临时 Runtime 的 state 目录。`LocalRuntimeProviderFactory.create` 在走临时 provisioner（`durable-local-process=false`）时补一次 `mkdir`；durable 路径不动，因为 `LocalRuntimeStore` 本来就会建。重试策略、断言、超时都没碰。

**为什么需要**：`SDK Java` 从 2026-11-11 起 nightly 红，现在挡住了必需的 `Managed Agent gate`。`HostedAutomationSpringCrashIT`（4/5）、`HostedPublicWorkspaceIT`、`HostedWorkspaceToolTurnIT` 报的都是同一句模糊超时（`warm turn completed timed out`）。真正原因是缺一个目录：`LocalProcessRuntimeProvisioner` 用 `state-directory` 作为 worker 的工作目录，临时 provisioner 没有 store 去建它，`LocalRuntimeProviderFactory.create` 也没建，于是 `ProcessBuilder.start()` 直接抛 `IOException`（`No such file or directory`）。该 IOException 被映射成**不可重试**的 `runtime_provision_failed`，`HarnessCoordinator.prepareRuntime` 又一直重试到 `harness.load-timeout` 上限，最终只暴露 `runtime_preparation_timeout` —— warm turn 根本没跑。同一条路径也解释了「Run long-answer persistence E2E」的 failover 失败（见 #17851）。

**怎么验证**：跑那几个原本红的 hosted fixture，看 warm turn 能否真正执行而不是撞加载超时。本地在 MySQL 8.4.11 + 打包的 `dist/cli.js`、`-Dspotbugs.skip=true`（`origin/main` 那条 SpotBugs 是 #17921，不是这张）下，单靠本次改动把 `HostedAutomationSpringCrashIT#fg11c2ScannerFiresOneOccurrenceOnMySql` 从 120s 超时变成 31s 通过；`WorkspaceCreationSchemaMySqlIT` + `ManagedWorkspaceArtifactMySqlIT` 在干净 schema 上 19/19。

**验证边界**：本 head 的 CI（含 failover 那条 job）尚未运行，我没有把它写成已通过；Windows 面未测，那条 `windows-latest` 失败已被上游 `2ebaac20284be` 修掉且红轮早于该提交。

**明确不在本 PR 内**：两条 MySQL 车道测试缺陷（#17893、#17917）、`origin/main` 的 SpotBugs（#17921）、Windows fixture（#17891）、runner disk floor 与 `tee` panic（#16003，属基建）。

</details>

## Highlights

_See the complete change list below._

## Breaking Changes

No known breaking changes.

## Complete Change List

### Features

- feat(web-shell): explain background tasks from the composer chips ([#17398](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17398)) by @wenshao
- Adds the backend-neutral unified chat surface contract and capability guards for Web Shell, with no user-visible behavior change yet. ([#17520](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17520)) by @wenshao
- feat(channels): add GitHub as the third managed channel adapter ([#17511](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17511)) by @wenshao

- feat(web-shell): send to another session with /send ([#17539](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17539)) by @qqqys
- Removes daemon dependencies from shared approval and composer components so the managed chat kernel can use them without loading daemon code. ([#17661](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17661)) by @wenshao

issues.title: execpolicy: -c$(…) / --command=$(…) flag-word substitution hides the resolved payload

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Something isn't working

labels.name: area:sandbox
labels.description: Sandbox, container, or OS-level isolation behavior

milestone.title: v0.10.4
milestone.description:
Planned follow-up: reliability hardening, replay/archive retention, cache-economics evidence, native CPU/IME investigation and bounded dead-code cleanup.

Undated planning target approved November 5, 2026, not a published release or a completion claim. Revalidate historical audit candidates against current source before implementing. Any confirmed defect that blocks the agreed 0.10.3 release must be promoted back immediately; this milestone is not a security or data-integrity waiver. Preserve recovery before applying retention limits, and obtain approval for paid-provider experiments.

issues.body:
## Why this matters
A nix launcher spelled `nix develop -c\$(echo rm) x` or `--command=\$(echo rm) x` renders the flag as static `-c`/`--command=`; the separated arm drops the flag word's `dynamic` flag, so the runtime-resolved payload escapes deny rules under `AskForApproval::Never`.

## Current behavior
`crates/execpolicy/src/shell_expand.rs` nix arm (~:2057-2099): on a substituted flag word the token renders to the static flag spelling and the child's `dynamic` bit is not propagated — the payload is treated as resolved-safe.

## Desired behavior
- `self.dynamic |= dynamic[at]` (or equivalent) so a flag position containing substitution marks the expansion unresolved → fail closed under deny rules.

## Repro or evidence
Adversarial-review vector on the audit V1 fix: `-c\$(echo rm) x` / `--command=\$(echo rm) x` not denied under deny-`rm` + `Never`, while the same payload unsubstituted is denied.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] substituted `-c`/`--command` spellings produce `dynamic` expansion (denied under deny-rm + Never)
- [ ] existing non-substituted spellings unchanged; `cargo test -p codewhale-execpolicy` passes

## Related
PR #7397, overnight audit V1

issues.title: execpolicy: unmodeled execution launchers (oc, vagrant, op, opam, helm)

labels.name: area:sandbox
labels.description: Sandbox, container, or OS-level isolation behavior

issues.body:
## Why this matters
Deny rules (e.g. prefix-deny `rm`) only hold for launchers the scanner models. Adversarial review of the execpolicy hardening branch verified that several common launchers run a deny-listed command with no deny target emitted: `oc rsh pod rm x` / `oc exec pod rm x`, `vagrant ssh -c 'rm x'`, `op run -- rm x`, `opam exec -- rm x`, `helm plugin`/post-render hooks and similar verb-bearing tools. `kubectl exec` and `docker container|compose` were closed in the same audit round; these remain.

## Current behavior
`crates/execpolicy/src/shell_expand.rs` models verb launchers through `VerbLauncher` + `launcher_verb_targets`. Unlisted programs treat their words as ordinary command words, so `oc exec pod -- rm x` emits no deny target for `rm`.

## Desired behavior
- Add spec tables + `VerbLauncher` entries for each launcher with a documented operand layout (pod/service consumed before the command words).
- Where a launcher accepts shell strings or hooks (helm post-renderer, op run env), emit the payload through `code_payload` or fail closed when the value is runtime-resolved.
- Deny-matrix rows in `crates/execpolicy/tests/shell_parse_policy.rs` for each new spelling, plus allow-list rows for inert verbs (`oc get pods`, `helm list`).

Refs #7397

issues.title: execpolicy: tmux execution verbs beyond the modeled set (display-popup, confirm-before, command-prompt, bind-key, source-file)
issues.body:
Round-10 correctness review (execpolicy-c1a55fdcbe) residual finding.

The tmux VerbLauncher models run-shell/run/send-keys/send/if-shell/if/pipe-pane/pipep, but tmux has more command-executing verbs:

- `tmux display-popup 'rm x'` — runs the command in a popup immediately
- `tmux confirm-before 'rm x'` — runs after a confirm prompt
- `tmux command-prompt -I 'rm x'` — user-editable command line
- `tmux bind-key k run-shell 'rm x'` — command bound to a key, executes on press
- `tmux source-file f` — reads commands from a file (file-content launchers may be a separate class)

Mechanism: execpolicy shell_expand.rs VERB_LAUNCHER_SPECS table — evaluate which verbs execute a command tail vs. which are inert, and model the executing ones with the operand-consumption rules each verb needs.

Discovered during execpolicy hardening review; see reviews/execpolicy-c1a55fdcbe-corr-devin.md for the full trace.

issues.title: execpolicy: whole-word dynamic flag/verb names bypass option scanners
issues.body:
Follow-up from the 0.10.3 execpolicy hardening review (PR #7397, round 6).

A word whose ENTIRE flag or verb text is runtime-resolved slips every scanner: `su $(echo -c) 'rm x'`, `nix $(echo develop) -c rm x`, `docker $(echo run) --entrypoint rm alpine`, `ssd --start $(echo --exec) rm -- x`. Verified `denied=false` on both the merge-base and the hardened head.

Mechanism: substitution contributes no text to the word, so it parses as empty + dynamic; every scanner arm requires `token.starts_with('-')` or a static flag/verb name, so the dynamic empty word matches nothing and its bit is dropped.

Proposed direction: in `command_heads`/scanner entry, an empty word with `dynamic=true` at a flag position should emit an unresolved marker (same ('',true) fail-closed shape as the option_payloads fix), and verb-resolution should treat a dynamic verb word as unresolvable rather than positional.

Not a regression — pre-existing on main. Severity: same deny-bypass class as the rest of the round.

issues.title: execpolicy: minor over/under-marks in stdin_piped propagation
issues.body:
Round-10 correctness review (execpolicy-c1a55fdcbe) residual findings, non-blocking. Assess each for accept-as-is vs narrow fix:

1. `x || ssh host` denies: the `|` arm fires on each `|` of `||`, marking the next line stdin_piped though nothing is piped. Over-mark.
2. `ssh host 3< f` denies: any `<`-family descriptor marks stdin_piped; fd-3 redirection is not stdin. `0<` vs `3<`/`{fd}<` not distinguished.
3. `ssh host ls <<EOF ... EOF` denies: heredoc body parsed as commands though it feeds the remote command's stdin. Over-deny unless the remote command evals it.
4. `echo 'rm x' | find . -exec ssh host \;` allows: record_find_exec builds its payload line with stdin_piped=false, but -exec children inherit find's stdin. Narrow under-mark.
5. `{ a; ssh h; }` after a pipe: only the first brace-member line gets stdin_piped; group stdin sharing not modeled. Narrow under-mark.
6. numactl spec still lists `strict` in long_values — latent table defect (bare `numactl --strict rm` allowed; destructive forms self-mitigate via head+1 emit).

See reviews/execpolicy-c1a55fdcbe-corr-devin.md for the full traces.

issues.title: execpolicy: static script payloads in awk/sed programs are not scanned

labels.name: area:sandbox
labels.description: Sandbox, container, or OS-level isolation behavior

issues.body:
## Why this matters
`awk 'BEGIN{system("rm x")}'` and `sed 's/x/rm y/e'` execute a deny-listed command from inside a fully static program text. The scanner inspects argv words only, so the payload never reaches a deny target. (The runtime-resolved sibling — `awk \$PROG`, `sed -e \$PROG` — was closed in the same audit round by `script_operands_dynamic`; the static case is the remaining half.)

## Current behavior
`crates/execpolicy/src/shell_expand.rs` records awk/sed heads and their operand words; the program text is opaque. Deny `rm` + `AskForApproval::Never` still allows the command.

## Desired behavior
- Scan awk program text for `system(`/`getline … | `getline`-pipe coprocess command strings and sed script text for the `e` flag on `s///`, `e`/`w`-with-command forms; emit any command payload through `code_payload`.
- Where the program text is dynamic, the existing `script_operands_dynamic` fail-closed already applies — keep that path.
- Deny-matrix rows for static `awk 'BEGIN{system("rm x")}'`, `sed 's/a/rm x/e'`, and allow-list rows for ordinary `awk '{print}`/`sed -n '/x/p'`.

Refs #7397

issues.title: Other read-only deferred tools still classify as Unknown in get_tool_category

labels.name: area:core
labels.description: Engine core: turn loop, agent loop, runtime

labels.name: area:state
labels.description: Sessions, persistence and the state store

issues.body:
Follow-up from the #7372 fix (#7406, e8b51b39).

`crates/engine/src/core/authority.rs` `get_tool_category()` has no arms for ~16 registered `ToolCapability::ReadOnly` tools, so they fall to `ToolCategory::Unknown` → `AskUser` in Auto-Review (`auto_review.rs:1582`) — the same web-session hold fixed for `load_skill`/`tool_search`/`handle_read`/`retrieve_tool_result`.

Still `Unknown` per two independent reviews: `lsp`, `context_archive_get`, `context_archive_search`, `session_get`, `session_search`, `memory_get`, `memory_search`, `project_map`, `validate_data`, `tui_help`, `notify`, `show_data`, `image_ocr`, `present`, `agents/list`, `agents/wait`, `git_merge_tree`, plus read-action canonical targets (`task_list`, `task_read`, `automation_list`, `automation_read`, `pr_attempt_*` reads). Each needs individual judgment before classifying — several run external processes (`image_ocr`, `pandoc_convert`) or reach the network, and `ReadOnly+Network` tools (`finance`, `verify`, `review`, `github_*`) arguably should stay held.

Also: legacy spellings `tool_search_tool_regex`/`tool_search_tool_bm25` remain dispatchable call names (`turn_loop.rs:1136-1146`, :2238) and still classify `Unknown` — an `is_tool_search_tool`-aware arm would cover them.

issues.title: execpolicy: find -delete is not treated as a destructive payload

labels.name: area:sandbox
labels.description: Sandbox, container, or OS-level isolation behavior

issues.body:
## Why this matters
`find` arguments are scanned for `-exec`/`-execdir` command payloads, but `-delete` removes every matched file with no command words at all — a deny rule on `rm` does not cover the equivalent deletion.

## Current behavior
`crates/execpolicy/src/shell_expand.rs` handles `-exec`/`-execdir` in `record_find_exec`; `-delete` is an ordinary predicate to the scanner, so `find . -name '*.bak' -delete` emits no deny target even where a same-repo policy denies `rm`.

## Desired behavior
- Decide policy semantics first (deny-list parity vs a dedicated destructive-action rule): either emit `-delete` as an `rm`-equivalent deny target or document that deletion-by-find needs its own rule name.
- If treated as rm-equivalent, add `-delete` (and GNU `-fls`/exec-shaped variants if any) to the find handling and add deny-matrix rows.

Refs #7397

issues.title: Session admission is held across the whole fork preparation, blocking unrelated threads

labels.name: area:tui
labels.description: Terminal UI behavior, rendering, or interaction

labels.name: area:state
labels.description: Sessions, persistence and the state store

issues.body:
## Summary

Forking a conversation by turn id (`/undo` with `turn_id`, and the retry endpoint) takes the manager-wide session admission guard and keeps it while the fork is prepared: the turn and item records are read, the source session document is captured and the fork is published. Because the guard is global, a fork of one conversation blocks restore, config and session operations on every other conversation for the fork's whole duration.

## Environment

Codewhale 0.10.2 at commit 6391f4f307040851fca29d679d3c05a985828a54, local runtime store, conversation with 1,200 user turns (2,400 stored items).

## Expected behavior

The admission guard should cover only the mutation that must be exclusive — resolving the cut and publishing the fork — not the read-only preparation and session copy. Acquiring the restore guard for an unrelated thread should not wait for a fork of another thread.

## Actual behavior

A named-turn fork of a 1,200-turn thread and, 20 ms later, a `thread_restore_guard` for a different thread:

| operation | duration |
| --- | --- |
| named-turn fork (1,200 turns) | 5,489 ms (4,237 ms in an earlier run) |
| restore guard for an unrelated thread | 5,468 ms (4,212 ms in the earlier run) |

The unrelated thread waited 99.6% of the fork's duration. The guard is manager-wide, so no restore or config reload could proceed while one conversation's fork was being prepared.

## Root cause

`fork_dropping_user_turn_in_sessions_dir` (crates/tui/src/runtime_threads.rs:13037) and `retry_thread_turn` (crates/tui/src/runtime_api.rs:8687) call `thread_restore_guard`, which takes `session_checkpoint_guard` — a single `RwLock` owned by the manager, not by the thread — and move the owned guard into the worker that calls `prepare_fork_at_user_message_in_sessions_dir` and `publish_prepared_fork`. The preparation reads `list_turns_for_thread`, `prepared_items_for_turns` and captures the session document inside the guarded scope.

## Suggested fix

Narrow the guarded scope: resolve the cut and publish under admission, but read the turns/items and capture the session copy outside it. Alternatively key admission by thread id (or by session document) so a fork of thread A cannot block a restore of thread B. If the session document is the resource that needs exclusion, take the guard only around the document write.

## Impact

Every named-turn undo or retry on a large conversation stalls unrelated restores and configuration reloads for seconds. A desktop client and a CLI attached to the same runtime serialize behind one conversation's fork; the larger the conversation, the longer the stall.

issues.title: TUI: full-screen erase + repaint on every window focus flashes on terminals without DEC 2026 (gnome-terminal/VTE)

labels.name: area:tui
labels.description: Terminal UI behavior, rendering, or interaction

labels.name: os:linux
labels.description: Linux-specific behaviour

issues.body:
## Summary

On every window focus gain (selecting the terminal window), the TUI erases the entire screen (`CSI 2J`) and repaints it from scratch, wrapped in DEC 2026 synchronized-update markers. On terminals that do not implement DEC 2026 (gnome-terminal / VTE < 0.76), the erase lands before the repaint, producing a visible flash/glitch on every focus. The repaint is byte-identical each time — nothing on screen changed.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Run codewhale (v0.10.2) in gnome-terminal (VTE 0.68) with any theme whose background differs from the terminal's default background (e.g. a light custom theme over a dark terminal background).
2. Switch away from the window and back (focus out, focus in).
3. Observe: a brief flash of the terminal's default background over the app surface on every focus-in.

## Expected vs actual

- Expected: focusing the window causes no visible redraw.
- Actual: full-screen erase + repaint on every FocusIn; visible flicker when the terminal ignores DEC 2026.

## Evidence

Captured over a pty with terminal emulation (xterm DA answers, focus events `CSI I` / `CSI O` sent explicitly). The FocusIn frame begins:

```
ESC[<1u ESC[>1u ESC[?1007l ESC[?1000h ESC[?1002h ESC[?1003h ESC[?1015h ESC[?1006h ESC[?2004h ESC[?1004h ESC[?2026h ESC[?25l ESC[r ESC[?6l ESC[H ESC[2J ESC[36;46H ESC[1;1H ...
```

i.e. mode re-setup (mouse tracking, bracketed paste, focus reporting), `?2026h` (begin synchronized update), cursor home, `2J` erase, then a full repaint, ending with `?2026l`.

Measurements (120x40 cells):

- Idle output: 0 bytes (diff-based rendering — nothing redraws while idle).
- Each FocusIn: ~6.7 KB full repaint; two consecutive FocusIn frames are **byte-identical** (redundant).
- FocusOut: 61 bytes.
- `synchronized_output = "off"` in settings removes the 2026 markers but keeps the identical erase + repaint.
- The app never issues a `DECRQM` (`CSI ?2026$p`) capability query — it emits `?2026h/l` unconditionally.

## Root cause

The focus handler unconditionally erases and fully repaints on FocusIn and relies on DEC 2026 to make it atomic. VTE ignores DEC 2026 until 0.76 (user's terminal: gnome-terminal 3.44.0 / libvte 0.68.0, Ubuntu). The erase therefore renders immediately with the terminal's default background, followed by the streamed repaint — visible as a flash. With a light theme over a dark terminal background the flash is very prominent.

## Suggested fixes

1. Detect DEC 2026 support via `DECRQM` before relying on it, and on non-supporting terminals either skip the erase or use a damage-only redraw.
2. Skip the erase entirely when nothing changed — the FocusIn repaint is redundant; diff-based rendering already achieves 0-byte idle.
3. If mode re-setup on focus is intentional (terminals may reset modes), keep it but drop `2J` and repaint only changed cells.

## Environment

- codewhale v0.10.2 (ff466b2ed0bf)
- gnome-terminal 3.44.0, libvte-2.91-0 0.68.0 (Ubuntu)
- Terminal default background: rgb(23,20,33); custom light theme background: #ECEFF4

Possibly related: #6728 (idle CPU regression).

issues.title: tui: GNOME Terminal background stays custom Nord theme color after exit

labels.name: area:tui
labels.description: Terminal UI behavior, rendering, or interaction

labels.name: area:install
labels.description: Install, npm wrapper, release artifacts, Homebrew, winget, Docker, Nix

labels.name: os:linux
labels.description: Linux-specific behaviour

issues.body:
## What happened?

After using CodeWhale in GNOME Terminal and exiting, the terminal profile keeps CodeWhale’s Nord light colors instead of restoring the previous profile colors. The background becomes `#ECEFF4` and the foreground `#2E3440`, while the palette remains Solarized. The terminal looks inconsistent outside CodeWhale.

Expected: CodeWhale restores the terminal’s previous background, foreground, and palette on exit, or leaves the existing profile colors untouched.

## Steps to reproduce

1. In GNOME Terminal, use a profile with the Solarized palette and a non-Nord background/foreground (for example Solarized Dark).
2. Configure CodeWhale with `theme = "custom:nord"` and a theme file containing `surface_bg: "#ECEFF4"` and `text_body: "#2E3440"`.
3. Run `codewhale` in that GNOME Terminal profile.
4. Exit CodeWhale normally.
5. Observe that the GNOME Terminal profile background/foreground remain the CodeWhale Nord colors instead of the previous colors.

## Codewhale version

`codewhale 0.10.2 (ff466b2ed0bf)`

## Where did it happen?

- TUI (terminal interface)

## Operating system

- Linux

## How did you get Codewhale?

- npm

## Provider and model

`deepseek / deepseek-flash`

## Terminal and shell

GNOME Terminal 3.44.0 using VTE 0.68.0; `TERM=xterm-256color`; `COLORTERM=truecolor`; `/bin/bash`.

## `codewhale doctor` (optional)

Not included; no relevant failure was observed.

## Logs, screenshots, anything else (optional)

- CodeWhale theme: `~/.codewhale/themes/nord.json` defines `surface_bg: "#ECEFF4"` and `text_body: "#2E3440"`.
- GNOME Terminal profile currently reports:
  - `use-theme-colors=false`
  - `background-color=rgb(236,239,244)` (`#ECEFF4`)
  - `foreground-color=rgb(46,52,64)` (`#2E3440`)
  - palette still Solarized (`#002B36`, `#FDF6E3`, etc.)
- CodeWhale’s binary contains OSC 11 handling (`crates/palette/src/osc11.rs`), and its logs show terminal probes for `\x1b]11;?` and `\x1b]10;?`.
- OpenCode 2.2.5 was also used under the same GNOME Terminal profile and has an identical Nord light background/foreground, so the exact writer is not fully isolated. Cross-reference: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/issues/63977
- The request is that the application setting OSC 10/11 restores the previous terminal colors on exit, or preserves the existing profile colors. A regression test for terminal color restoration would help.
- Workaround: reset the GNOME Terminal profile colors with `gsettings`.
- I searched existing issues and did not find a duplicate.

## Isolation steps not yet completed

1. Test whether `printf '\033]111\007'` and `printf '\033]110\007'` restore the dynamic background/foreground.
2. Reproduce with CodeWhale alone, then OpenCode alone, to identify which process writes the profile colors.

issues.title: Proposal: a maintainer gate before agent work, and a regression stage after it

labels.name: bug

labels.name: enhancement
labels.description: New feature or request
